entries.shortAnswer: 「拆台」的英文是 undermine someone in public，指当众拆穿或让人下不来台。注意与「拆墙脚」（挖人、破坏根基）区分。
entries.definition: undermine someone in public 强调在公开场合削弱对方威信，常与 embarrass、humiliate 连用；口语也可说 call someone out。拆台是社交博弈，拆墙脚是背后挖人。

examples.en: He tried to undermine me in public during the meeting, but I stayed calm and answered every question.
examples.zh: 他在会上想当众拆我的台，但我保持冷静，回答了每个问题。

examples.en: Don't undermine her in public; if you have a problem, talk to her privately.
examples.zh: 别当众拆她的台；有问题私下跟她说。

entries.shortAnswer: “Undermine someone in public”的中文意思是「拆台」，指当众让人下不来台。它侧重公开削弱威信，而非背后使坏。
entries.definition: undermine someone in public 指在公开场合削弱某人权威或面子，常见搭配：undermine authority/credibility。正式场合用，口语可说 call out。易错：不是「拆墙脚」（poach）。

examples.en: He tried to undermine me in public during the meeting, but I stayed calm and answered every question.
examples.zh: 他在会上想当众拆我的台，但我保持冷静，回答了每个问题。

examples.en: Don't undermine her in public; if you have a problem, talk to her privately.
examples.zh: 别当众拆她的台；有问题私下跟她说。

entries.shortAnswer: 「站队」的英文是 take sides，指在争议或派系中明确选边表态。中文里常含被迫或功利的意味，英文 take sides 则偏中性，是否负面看语境。
entries.definition: 常用搭配：take sides on an issue、refuse to take sides。注意：中文「站队」常带职场政治、舆论压力色彩，不表态也可能被视为一种表态；英文 take sides 本身只强调选边，褒贬由上下文决定。

examples.en: In the office debate, I tried to stay neutral, but refusing to take sides only made both teams distrust me.
examples.zh: 在办公室的争论中，我试图保持中立，但拒绝站队反而让两边的人都不信任我。

examples.en: She finally took sides with her best friend, even though it meant going against the rest of the group.
examples.zh: 她最终站到了最好的朋友那边，即使这意味着与团队其余的人作对。

entries.shortAnswer: Take sides means「站队」，指在争论或派系中支持某一方。它强调明确选边，而 pick a side 更口语，sit on the fence 则指不站队。
entries.definition: Take sides 常用于争论、冲突、选举等场景，搭配有 take sides against/with someone。正式和口语皆可。易错点：它不等于「支持」的泛义，而特指在已有对立两方时选边。

examples.en: In the office debate, I tried to stay neutral, but refusing to take sides only made both teams distrust me.
examples.zh: 在办公室的争论中，我试图保持中立，但拒绝站队反而让两边的人都不信任我。

examples.en: She finally took sides with her best friend, even though it meant going against the rest of the group.
examples.zh: 她最终站到了最好的朋友那边，即使这意味着与团队其余的人作对。

entries.shortAnswer: 「和好」的英文是 make up after a fight，指吵架或冲突后和解。注意 make up 单独用可表示「化妆」或「编造」，需靠 after a fight 等语境判断。
entries.definition: make up after a fight 强调争吵后主动恢复关系，常搭配 argue、quarrel、fall out 等。与 get back together 不同，后者特指分手后复合，而和好不一定曾分手。

examples.en: They argued about the project for hours, but finally made up after a fight and went to grab coffee together.
examples.zh: 他们为那个项目吵了好几个小时，但最终和好了，还一起去喝了咖啡。

examples.en: It's normal for couples to make up after a fight; what matters is talking it through honestly.
examples.zh: 情侣吵架后和好很正常，重要的是坦诚沟通、把问题说开。

entries.shortAnswer: make up after a fight 的中文意思是「和好」，指争吵后和解、恢复友好。语义核心是结束冲突，而非像 get back together 那样专指分手后复合。
entries.definition: make up after a fight 用于日常口语和书面语，表示吵架后和好。可分开说 make up，但需靠 after a fight 或 with sb 明确。易错：make up 还有「化妆」「编造」义。

examples.en: They argued about the project for hours, but finally made up after a fight and went to grab coffee together.
examples.zh: 他们为那个项目吵了好几个小时，但最终和好了，还一起去喝了咖啡。

examples.en: It's normal for couples to make up after a fight; what matters is talking it through honestly.
examples.zh: 情侣吵架后和好很正常，重要的是坦诚沟通、把问题说开。

entries.translation: argue for the sake of arguing
entries.shortAnswer: 「抬杠」的英文是 argue for the sake of arguing，指为反驳而反驳、习惯性争论，常含贬义。
entries.definition: argue for the sake of arguing 指没有实质目的、只为反驳而争论，带贬义，类似中文“杠精”。口语中可说 stop arguing for the sake of arguing。

examples.en: Don't argue for the sake of arguing—tell me what you actually want to change.
examples.zh: 别抬杠了，告诉我你到底想改什么。

examples.en: He always argues for the sake of arguing, even when everyone agrees with him.
examples.zh: 他总爱抬杠，哪怕所有人都同意他的观点。

entries.term: argue for the sake of arguing
entries.shortAnswer: argue for the sake of arguing 的中文意思是「抬杠」，即为反驳而反驳、习惯性争论，常含贬义。
entries.definition: 该短语指没有实际目的、只为反驳而争论，类似中文“抬杠/杠精”。常见搭配：just argue for the sake of arguing。多用于口语，带批评语气。

examples.en: Don't argue for the sake of arguing—tell me what you actually want to change.
examples.zh: 别抬杠了，告诉我你到底想改什么。

examples.en: He always argues for the sake of arguing, even when everyone agrees with him.
examples.zh: 他总爱抬杠，哪怕所有人都同意他的观点。

entries.shortAnswer: 「暧昧」可译为 ambiguous romance，指比友情多、比爱情少、没名分的关系。
entries.definition: ambiguous romance 指双方亲密却未确认关系的状态，可搭配 be in/have an ambiguous romance。

examples.en: They've been in an ambiguous romance for months, holding hands but never calling each other boyfriend or girlfriend.
examples.zh: 他们暧昧了好几个月，会牵手，却从没称对方为男朋友或女朋友。

examples.en: She finally asked him to define their ambiguous romance because she was tired of guessing.
examples.zh: 她终于让他给这段暧昧关系一个说法，因为她厌倦了猜来猜去。

entries.shortAnswer: Ambiguous romance means 暧昧: more than friends, less than lovers, with no clear label.
entries.definition: Ambiguous romance 指亲密却未定名的关系，类似 situationship，可搭配 be in/have an ambiguous romance。

examples.en: They've been in an ambiguous romance for months, holding hands but never calling each other boyfriend or girlfriend.
examples.zh: 他们暧昧了好几个月，会牵手，却从没称对方为男朋友或女朋友。

examples.en: She finally asked him to define their ambiguous romance because she was tired of guessing.
examples.zh: 她终于让他给这段暧昧关系一个说法，因为她厌倦了猜来猜去。

entries.shortAnswer: 「绝交」的英文是 cut off a friendship，指彻底断绝朋友往来，比暂时冷战更决绝。
entries.definition: cut off a friendship 指彻底终止朋友关系，语气偏正式，常因背叛或原则冲突。

examples.en: After he spread rumors about her, she decided to cut off a friendship with him for good.
examples.zh: 在他散布关于她的谣言后，她决定与他彻底绝交。

examples.en: They did not argue; he simply cut off a friendship and never replied again.
examples.zh: 他们没有争吵，他只是默默绝交，从此再没回复。

entries.shortAnswer: "Cut off a friendship" means 绝交: to end a friendship fully and on purpose, not just pause it.
entries.definition: Use "cut off a friendship" for a deliberate, final break with a friend, often over betrayal.

examples.en: After he spread rumors about her, she decided to cut off a friendship with him for good.
examples.zh: 在他散布关于她的谣言后，她决定与他彻底绝交。

examples.en: They did not argue; he simply cut off a friendship and never replied again.
examples.zh: 他们没有争吵，他只是默默绝交，从此再没回复。

entries.shortAnswer: 「表白」的英文是 confess feelings，指向喜欢的人坦白爱慕，比 tell someone I like you 更正式。
entries.definition: confess feelings 强调坦白对某人的爱意，常搭配 confess feelings for/to someone，日常也可说 tell someone how I feel。

examples.en: He finally worked up the courage to confess feelings to her.
examples.zh: 他终于鼓起勇气向她表白了。

examples.en: Confessing feelings can be scary, but it's better than staying in an ambiguous relationship forever.
examples.zh: 表白可能很让人害怕，但总比一直暧昧不清要好。

entries.shortAnswer: “confess feelings”的意思是「表白」，向喜欢的人坦白爱慕，比 tell someone I like you 更郑重。
entries.definition: confess feelings 指主动坦白对某人的爱意，常见搭配 confess feelings for/to someone，多用于恋爱社交语境。

examples.en: He finally worked up the courage to confess feelings to her.
examples.zh: 他终于鼓起勇气向她表白了。

examples.en: Confessing feelings can be scary, but it's better than staying in an ambiguous relationship forever.
examples.zh: 表白可能很让人害怕，但总比一直暧昧不清要好。

entries.shortAnswer: 「复合」的英文是 get back together，指分手后的恋人重新在一起，强调恢复恋爱关系。
entries.definition: get back together 专指恋人分手后重新交往，主语常用复数或两人。朋友吵架和好用 make up，别混用。

examples.en: They broke up last year, but they got back together after realizing they still loved each other.
examples.zh: 他们去年分手了，但在意识到彼此仍然相爱后复合了。

examples.en: I don't think it's a good idea to get back together with your ex just because you're lonely.
examples.zh: 我觉得仅仅因为寂寞就和前任复合不是什么好主意。

entries.shortAnswer: get back together 的中文意思是「复合」，专指分手后的情侣重新确立恋爱关系。
entries.definition: get back together 口语和书面都常用，主语多为两人或复数，如 We got back together last month.

examples.en: They broke up last year, but they got back together after realizing they still loved each other.
examples.zh: 他们去年分手了，但在意识到彼此仍然相爱后复合了。

examples.en: I don't think it's a good idea to get back together with your ex just because you're lonely.
examples.zh: 我觉得仅仅因为寂寞就和前任复合不是什么好主意。

entries.shortAnswer: 蹭饭的英文是 tag along for a meal，指跟着别人白吃一顿。蹭自带自嘲和占便宜感，强调非正式、非主动邀请，和搭伙吃饭不同。
entries.definition: 蹭饭是口语自谦说法，强调没被正式邀请却跟着去白吃。英文常用 tag along for a meal/free meal，也可说 mooch a meal（更贬义）。注意蹭字家族如蹭网、蹭热度都带自嘲式占便宜语感。

examples.en: My roommate said he was ordering takeout with friends, so I decided to tag along for a meal.
examples.zh: 我室友说他要和朋友点外卖，于是我决定跟着蹭一顿饭。

examples.en: Whenever my sister visits, she always tags along for a meal at my place without asking.
examples.zh: 每次我姐来，她总是不打招呼就来我这儿蹭饭。

entries.shortAnswer: tag along for a meal 的中文意思是蹭饭，即跟着别人去白吃一顿。它比 join for dinner 多出未经邀请、顺带占便宜的自嘲意味。
entries.definition: tag along for a meal 多用于口语和非正式社交，指跟着熟人去吃饭而不付钱或未被正式邀请。核心是 tag along（跟随、附着）带消极被动感，常自嘲说 I'll just tag along。与 freeload 不同，它贬义更轻，强调顺带而非刻意占便宜。

examples.en: My roommate said he was ordering takeout with friends, so I decided to tag along for a meal.
examples.zh: 我室友说他要和朋友点外卖，于是我决定跟着蹭一顿饭。

examples.en: Whenever my sister visits, she always tags along for a meal at my place without asking.
examples.zh: 每次我姐来，她总是不打招呼就来我这儿蹭饭。

entries.shortAnswer: 「脱单」的英文是 stop being single，字面即“不再单身”，强调状态改变，口语轻松。
entries.definition: stop being single 是中性口语表达，指结束单身状态，不点明对象是谁，也不等于结婚。常见搭配：finally stop being single（终于脱单）。

examples.en: My cousin finally stopped being single at thirty-five and his parents were thrilled.
examples.zh: 我表哥三十五岁终于脱单了，他父母高兴坏了。

examples.en: She jokes that moving to a new city is the quickest way to stop being single.
examples.zh: 她开玩笑说，搬到一个新城市是脱单最快的方法。

entries.shortAnswer: Stop being single 的中文意思是「脱单」，即结束单身状态，强调状态转变，比 get a partner 更口语化。
entries.definition: stop being single 用于口语，指不再单身，常带调侃语气，只表示脱离单身，不含结婚承诺。常见搭配：finally stop being single。

examples.en: My cousin finally stopped being single at thirty-five and his parents were thrilled.
examples.zh: 我表哥三十五岁终于脱单了，他父母高兴坏了。

examples.en: She jokes that moving to a new city is the quickest way to stop being single.
examples.zh: 她开玩笑说，搬到一个新城市是脱单最快的方法。

entries.shortAnswer: 「随叫随到」英文说 on call for friends，强调朋友需要时随时出现。注意 on call 本指值班待命，用于朋友间是自嘲式夸张。
entries.definition: on call 原指医生等职业待命，加 for friends 后带幽默自嘲：像值班一样对朋友有求必应。常与 always、basically 连用，如 I'm always on call for friends。

examples.en: She's basically on call for friends, ready to help at any hour.
examples.zh: 她基本上对朋友随叫随到，随时准备帮忙。

examples.en: Being on call for friends can be exhausting, but he never says no.
examples.zh: 对朋友随叫随到可能很累，但他从不拒绝。

entries.shortAnswer: 「on call for friends」中文意思是「随叫随到」，指朋友一叫就出现。与 just be there 不同，它借用值班待命意象，带自嘲夸张色彩。
entries.definition: on call 本义是职业待命，for friends 将其延伸到友情，表示对朋友有求必应、随时支援。口语中常自嘲，如 I'm basically on call for friends。

examples.en: She's basically on call for friends, ready to help at any hour.
examples.zh: 她基本上对朋友随叫随到，随时准备帮忙。

examples.en: Being on call for friends can be exhausting, but he never says no.
examples.zh: 对朋友随叫随到可能很累，但他从不拒绝。

entries.shortAnswer: 见面礼的英文是 first-meeting gift，指初次见面时赠送的礼物，别与 greeting 混淆。
entries.definition: first-meeting gift 多用于正式或礼节性场合，如见家长、拜访客户、拜师。口语也可说 a gift for our first meeting。

examples.en: When meeting my girlfriend's parents for the first time, I brought a first-meeting gift to show my respect.
examples.zh: 第一次见女朋友的父母时，我带了一份见面礼以示尊重。

examples.en: In Chinese business culture, exchanging first-meeting gifts can help break the ice.
examples.zh: 在中国商务文化中，互赠见面礼有助于打破僵局。

entries.shortAnswer: first-meeting gift 的中文意思是见面礼，即初次见面时送的礼物，强调第一次见面。
entries.definition: first-meeting gift 指为初次会面准备的礼物，常见于见长辈、相亲、商务拜访，可搭配 give 或 bring。

examples.en: When meeting my girlfriend's parents for the first time, I brought a first-meeting gift to show my respect.
examples.zh: 第一次见女朋友的父母时，我带了一份见面礼以示尊重。

examples.en: In Chinese business culture, exchanging first-meeting gifts can help break the ice.
examples.zh: 在中国商务文化中，互赠见面礼有助于打破僵局。

entries.shortAnswer: 应酬的英文是 social obligations，指不得不参加的社交活动，常含义务与压力意味。
entries.definition: 应酬多用 social obligations，强调因人情或工作需要而必须参与，常搭配 fulfill 或 avoid。

examples.en: He often attends business dinners as part of his social obligations, even when he would rather stay home.
examples.zh: 作为应酬的一部分，他经常参加商务晚宴，即使他更想待在家里。

examples.en: During the holidays, many people feel overwhelmed by social obligations like family gatherings and company parties.
examples.zh: 节假日期间，许多人被家庭聚会和公司派对等应酬压得喘不过气。

entries.shortAnswer: Social obligations means 应酬, referring to mandatory social activities one must attend out of duty.
entries.definition: Social obligations are duties to attend social events, often work or family related, implying pressure rather than free choice.

examples.en: He often attends business dinners as part of his social obligations, even when he would rather stay home.
examples.zh: 作为应酬的一部分，他经常参加商务晚宴，即使他更想待在家里。

examples.en: During the holidays, many people feel overwhelmed by social obligations like family gatherings and company parties.
examples.zh: 节假日期间，许多人被家庭聚会和公司派对等应酬压得喘不过气。

entries.shortAnswer: 「人情债」英文是 debt of gratitude，指受恩后觉得亏欠、需要回报的心理负担；口语也可说 owe someone one，但语气更轻。
entries.definition: debt of gratitude 表示感激与亏欠交织，常搭配 owe a debt of gratitude to someone、repay a debt of gratitude。它指道德或情感亏欠，不是金钱债；欠钱应说 owe someone money。

examples.en: After all these years, I still owe him a debt of gratitude for helping me through college.
examples.zh: 这么多年过去，我仍欠他一份人情债，感谢他帮我读完大学。

examples.en: She felt a deep debt of gratitude to the neighbors who took her in during the storm.
examples.zh: 她对暴风雨中收留她的邻居心怀深深的人情债。

entries.shortAnswer: debt of gratitude 中文是「人情债」，指因受恩而心存亏欠、觉得该回报；比 owe someone one 正式，强调道德情感亏欠，并非欠钱。
entries.definition: 核心义为因受恩而产生的感激与回报义务，常见搭配 owe a debt of gratitude to someone、repay a debt of gratitude。正式书面和演讲中常见，口语多说 owe someone one。

examples.en: After all these years, I still owe him a debt of gratitude for helping me through college.
examples.zh: 这么多年过去，我仍欠他一份人情债，感谢他帮我读完大学。

examples.en: She felt a deep debt of gratitude to the neighbors who took her in during the storm.
examples.zh: 她对暴风雨中收留她的邻居心怀深深的人情债。

entries.shortAnswer: 「熟人不熟」的英文对应词是 frenemy，专指表面亲近、暗地较劲的亦友亦敌关系，词由 friend 和 enemy 拼合。
entries.definition: frenemy 由 friend 与 enemy 组合而成，指表面友好、实则暗中竞争或较劲的人，常见于职场与朋友圈。

examples.en: She always compliments my outfit and then jokes about my taste—classic frenemy move.
examples.zh: 她总是先夸我的穿搭，接着又拿我的品味开玩笑，典型的「熟人不熟」操作。

examples.en: We used to be frenemies in college, competing over grades while still grabbing lunch together.
examples.zh: 我们大学时就是「熟人不熟」的关系，一边较劲成绩，一边还能一起吃饭。

entries.shortAnswer: The English word for 「熟人不熟」 is frenemy—a person who acts friendly but quietly competes with you.
entries.definition: A frenemy is someone you socialize with but who subtly competes with or undermines you, common in workplace and social circles.

examples.en: She always compliments my outfit and then jokes about my taste—classic frenemy move.
examples.zh: 她总是先夸我的穿搭，接着又拿我的品味开玩笑，典型的「熟人不熟」操作。

examples.en: We used to be frenemies in college, competing over grades while still grabbing lunch together.
examples.zh: 我们大学时就是「熟人不熟」的关系，一边较劲成绩，一边还能一起吃饭。

entries.shortAnswer: 「捧杀」的英文是 praise someone into a trap，意思是用吹捧把人夸进坑里。
entries.definition: praise someone into a trap 指用过度吹捧让人膨胀招忌、最终自毁，可评价他人手段或自嘲。口语也说 praise someone to death。

examples.en: His colleagues praised him into a trap, and he took on a project that destroyed his career.
examples.zh: 同事们把他捧杀了，结果他接手了一个毁掉自己职业前途的项目。

examples.en: Don't let strangers online praise you into a trap; they just want to watch you fall.
examples.zh: 别让网上的陌生人把你捧杀了，他们只是想看你摔下来。

entries.shortAnswer: praise someone into a trap means 捧杀: to flatter someone until it ruins them.
entries.definition: Used when flattery is a tactic: rivals or haters puff you up until you overreach. Don't mistake it for a real compliment.

examples.en: His colleagues praised him into a trap, and he took on a project that destroyed his career.
examples.zh: 同事们把他捧杀了，结果他接手了一个毁掉自己职业前途的项目。

examples.en: Don't let strangers online praise you into a trap; they just want to watch you fall.
examples.zh: 别让网上的陌生人把你捧杀了，他们只是想看你摔下来。

entries.shortAnswer: 「捧哏」英文是 straight man in comedy，指相声或喜剧中接话垫话、衬托逗哏的搭档。别译成 flatterer。
entries.definition: 用法：多指相声或喜剧里与逗哏（funny man）相对的搭档角色。搭配：play the straight man、be the straight man to someone。易错：不是捧场者或马屁精。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese crosstalk, the straight man in comedy feeds lines and feigns ignorance so the funny man can deliver the punchline.
examples.zh: 在传统相声中，捧哏负责垫话和装傻，让逗哏能抖出包袱。

examples.en: She plays the straight man in comedy perfectly, reacting with deadpan confusion while her partner escalates the joke.
examples.zh: 她捧哏捧得恰到好处，一脸茫然地接话，而搭档则把笑料越推越高。

entries.shortAnswer: Straight man in comedy 意思是「捧哏」，即喜剧中一本正经接话、衬托逗哏的搭档，别误解为直男。
entries.definition: 核心义：喜剧或相声里配合 funny man 的严肃搭档。搭配：play the straight man、be someone's straight man。易错：不是异性恋男性或直男。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese crosstalk, the straight man in comedy feeds lines and feigns ignorance so the funny man can deliver the punchline.
examples.zh: 在传统相声中，捧哏负责垫话和装傻，让逗哏能抖出包袱。

examples.en: She plays the straight man in comedy perfectly, reacting with deadpan confusion while her partner escalates the joke.
examples.zh: 她捧哏捧得恰到好处，一脸茫然地接话，而搭档则把笑料越推越高。

entries.shortAnswer: 「怼人」的英文是 clap back at someone，指被人冒犯后立刻犀利回击，快而狠，句句占上风，不是单纯反驳。
entries.definition: clap back at someone 多用于口语和社交媒体，语气可轻可重：朋友互怼是玩笑，陌生人互怼可能升级成争吵。它侧重回击，主动开骂该用 start a fight。

examples.en: When a troll insulted her outfit, she clapped back at him with a photo of her award.
examples.zh: 有个喷子嘲讽她的穿搭，她直接甩出一张获奖照片怼了回去。

examples.en: He is not afraid to clap back at someone who spreads rumors about him.
examples.zh: 谁要是散布关于他的谣言，他从不害怕怼回去。

entries.shortAnswer: clap back at someone 的中文意思是「怼人」，即被人冒犯后立刻用犀利话语回击对方，强调迅速反击、句句有力。
entries.definition: clap back at someone 属非正式表达，常见于网络评论，搭配有 clap back at a hater/a troll。语气可轻可重；它指回击对方，正式场合宜改用 respond sharply。

examples.en: When a troll insulted her outfit, she clapped back at him with a photo of her award.
examples.zh: 有个喷子嘲讽她的穿搭，她直接甩出一张获奖照片怼了回去。

examples.en: He is not afraid to clap back at someone who spreads rumors about him.
examples.zh: 谁要是散布关于他的谣言，他从不害怕怼回去。

entries.shortAnswer: 「内耗」的英文是 internal friction，指自我怀疑与反复纠结造成的精神消耗。
entries.definition: internal friction 本为物理术语，指系统内部的摩擦损耗；心理学借用后表示把精力耗在自我怀疑、反复权衡与内心冲突上。常见搭配：mental internal friction。注意它不等于 depression（抑郁）或焦虑症。

examples.en: She spent the whole weekend in internal friction, replaying the conversation and blaming herself.
examples.zh: 她整个周末都在内耗，反复回想那次对话并责怪自己。

examples.en: Too much internal friction can wear you out faster than any external pressure.
examples.zh: 过多的内耗比任何外部压力都更快让人精疲力尽。

entries.shortAnswer: internal friction 的中文意思是「内耗」，指自我纠结与内心冲突带来的精神消耗。
entries.definition: internal friction 字面指物体内部的摩擦，心理学借用后表示因自我怀疑、过度思考和内心拉扯而耗尽精力。常见搭配：mental internal friction、experience internal friction。正式与口语均可，但不用作临床诊断术语。

examples.en: She spent the whole weekend in internal friction, replaying the conversation and blaming herself.
examples.zh: 她整个周末都在内耗，反复回想那次对话并责怪自己。

examples.en: Too much internal friction can wear you out faster than any external pressure.
examples.zh: 过多的内耗比任何外部压力都更快让人精疲力尽。

entries.shortAnswer: 「精神内耗」的英文是 mental exhaustion from overthinking，指自我拉扯、反复纠结导致的内心消耗。它描述一种疲惫状态，不是临床诊断，别和 depression 混用。
entries.definition: 常用搭配：suffer from mental exhaustion from overthinking、get caught in overthinking。强调因想太多、自我怀疑而心累，属状态描述；clinical depression 才是医学诊断，不可替换。

examples.en: After weeks of mental exhaustion from overthinking every decision, she finally asked a friend for advice.
examples.zh: 在因为对每个决定都过度思虑而精神内耗了几周后，她终于向朋友求助。

examples.en: He realized his mental exhaustion from overthinking was not depression, just a habit of second-guessing himself.
examples.zh: 他意识到自己的精神内耗并非抑郁，只是一种反复自我怀疑的习惯。

entries.shortAnswer: mental exhaustion from overthinking 的中文意思是「精神内耗」，指被过度思虑拖垮的心累状态，并非临床抑郁症。它强调自我拉扯与反复纠结，而非情绪低落本身。
entries.definition: 该短语偏口语与网络语境，常见于 suffer from、deal with 之后；正式写作可用 chronic overthinking 替代。注意它描述主观疲惫状态，不能当作 depression 等临床术语使用。

examples.en: After weeks of mental exhaustion from overthinking every decision, she finally asked a friend for advice.
examples.zh: 在因为对每个决定都过度思虑而精神内耗了几周后，她终于向朋友求助。

examples.en: He realized his mental exhaustion from overthinking was not depression, just a habit of second-guessing himself.
examples.zh: 他意识到自己的精神内耗并非抑郁，只是一种反复自我怀疑的习惯。

entries.shortAnswer: 「补刀」的英文是 finish someone off with words，用言语完成最后一击，也常说 twist the knife，社交中表示在对方受伤时再扎心一句。
entries.definition: 补刀源自游戏 last hit，指对残血敌人完成最后一击；引申为在别人已受伤或难堪时，再用一句话追加打击。英文 finish someone off with words 保留游戏本义，twist the knife 则更地道，表示伤口上撒盐。

examples.en: Everyone was already laughing at his failed presentation, and then she finished him off with words by asking if he had even rehearsed once.
examples.zh: 大家已经在笑他失败的演讲，然后她补刀问他有没有排练过一次。

examples.en: He tried to defend his mistake, but his teammate finished him off with words, saying the client had warned them about this exact problem last week.
examples.zh: 他试图为自己的错误辩解，但队友补刀说客户上周就警告过这个具体问题。

entries.shortAnswer: finish someone off with words 的中文是「补刀」，指用言语给对方最后一击，近义 twist the knife，但更强调终结性的一击。
entries.definition: finish someone off with words 字面为用言语完成最后一击，源自游戏 last hit，社交中比喻在对方已处劣势或受伤时再补一句扎心的话，口语常用，正式写作较少。

examples.en: Everyone was already laughing at his failed presentation, and then she finished him off with words by asking if he had even rehearsed once.
examples.zh: 大家已经在笑他失败的演讲，然后她补刀问他有没有排练过一次。

examples.en: He tried to defend his mistake, but his teammate finished him off with words, saying the client had warned them about this exact problem last week.
examples.zh: 他试图为自己的错误辩解，但队友补刀说客户上周就警告过这个具体问题。

entries.shortAnswer: 「独处」的英文是 time alone。它强调主动留出时间与自己相处，不等于孤独 lonely 或 solitude 的文学感。
entries.definition: time alone 是中性偏积极的表达，指主动独处、给自己留空间，常用 need / want / enjoy / get some time alone；lonely 才带孤独难过的负面感。

examples.en: After a long week of meetings, I really need some time alone.
examples.zh: 开了一整周的会之后，我真的需要一点独处的时间。

examples.en: She enjoys time alone with a book and a cup of tea.
examples.zh: 她喜欢捧一本书、泡一杯茶，享受独处。

entries.shortAnswer: time alone 的中文意思是「独处」，指主动留出时间与自己相处。它强调选择独处，不等于 lonely（孤独难过）。
entries.definition: time alone 指有意不与他人相处、恢复精力或思考的时间，口语中常说 need some time alone、enjoy time alone；与 lonely 情绪不同。

examples.en: After a long week of meetings, I really need some time alone.
examples.zh: 开了一整周的会之后，我真的需要一点独处的时间。

examples.en: She enjoys time alone with a book and a cup of tea.
examples.zh: 她喜欢捧一本书、泡一杯茶，享受独处。

entries.shortAnswer: 「抬轿」的英文是 hype someone up，指帮人吹嘘造势、捧场站台。
entries.definition: 口语中指用夸张言辞帮某人抬高声势，如互相吹捧、粉丝造势，常带炒作或捧杀意味。

examples.en: His friends kept hyping him up before the interview, calling him the best candidate.
examples.zh: 面试前朋友们一直给他抬轿，说他是最佳人选。

examples.en: Fans hyped the young singer up online, making her trend overnight.
examples.zh: 粉丝在网上为这位年轻歌手抬轿，让她一夜走红。

entries.shortAnswer: 「抬轿」 means hype someone up: to build someone up with exaggerated praise.
entries.definition: To hype someone up is to promote or encourage them with exaggerated words, often creating buzz and implying overpraise.

examples.en: His friends kept hyping him up before the interview, calling him the best candidate.
examples.zh: 面试前朋友们一直给他抬轿，说他是最佳人选。

examples.en: Fans hyped the young singer up online, making her trend overnight.
examples.zh: 粉丝在网上为这位年轻歌手抬轿，让她一夜走红。

entries.shortAnswer: 「摆烂」可译作 let things rot on purpose，指有意放任事情变糟。
entries.definition: 用法：let things rot on purpose 强调主动放弃补救，带自嘲意味，与被动不争的躺平不同。

examples.en: After failing twice, he chose to let things rot on purpose and stopped studying.
examples.zh: 两次不及格后，他选择摆烂，干脆不再学习。

examples.en: She kept her job but let things rot on purpose by ignoring every email and deadline.
examples.zh: 她没辞职，却用无视所有邮件和截止日期的方式摆烂。

entries.shortAnswer: To let things rot on purpose is 摆烂: deliberately letting things worsen, with a self-mocking tone.
entries.definition: To let things rot on purpose means 摆烂: intentionally allowing a situation to worsen. It is active, unlike passive 躺平.

examples.en: After failing twice, he chose to let things rot on purpose and stopped studying.
examples.zh: 两次不及格后，他选择摆烂，干脆不再学习。

examples.en: She kept her job but let things rot on purpose by ignoring every email and deadline.
examples.zh: 她没辞职，却用无视所有邮件和截止日期的方式摆烂。

entries.shortAnswer: 「周日焦虑」的英文是 Sunday scaries，指周日晚想到周一上班就心慌恐惧。注意它非临床诊断，而是口语化的网络心理热词。
entries.definition: Sunday scaries 为复数名词，常搭 get/have the Sunday scaries，表示周末尾声的焦虑感。中国版还叠加「周一例会恐惧」，语境更具体。

examples.en: I always get the Sunday scaries when I think about my Monday morning meeting.
examples.zh: 一想到周一早上的例会，我就犯周日焦虑。

examples.en: Her Sunday scaries were so bad that she started preparing for work on Saturday night.
examples.zh: 她的周日焦虑太严重了，周六晚上就开始为工作做准备。

entries.shortAnswer: Sunday scaries 的中文意思是「周日焦虑」，指周日晚因想到周一工作而焦虑不安。它不等于临床焦虑症，而是轻松自嘲的口语热词。
entries.definition: Sunday scaries 是复数俚语名词，常作 get/have the Sunday scaries，口语多用于朋友吐槽和社媒。指周末结束前的焦虑，非正式诊断。

examples.en: I always get the Sunday scaries when I think about my Monday morning meeting.
examples.zh: 一想到周一早上的例会，我就犯周日焦虑。

examples.en: Her Sunday scaries were so bad that she started preparing for work on Saturday night.
examples.zh: 她的周日焦虑太严重了，周六晚上就开始为工作做准备。

entries.shortAnswer: 「松弛感」的英文是 effortless ease，指不费力的从容状态，情绪稳定而不紧绷。
entries.definition: 常用搭配：with effortless ease、a sense of effortless ease。强调情绪稳定、不紧绷；与消极怠工不同。

examples.en: She handled the tough questions with effortless ease, as if she had all the time in the world.
examples.zh: 她从容不迫地应对了那些刁钻问题，仿佛拥有世间所有的余裕。

examples.en: His effortless ease in social situations makes people feel comfortable around him.
examples.zh: 他在社交场合中那种不费力的松弛感，让周围的人都感到舒服。

entries.shortAnswer: The English for 「松弛感」 is effortless ease: a calm, unforced state of being.
entries.definition: Effortless ease means being calm and natural, not tense. Common collocations: with effortless ease, a sense of effortless ease.

examples.en: She handled the tough questions with effortless ease, as if she had all the time in the world.
examples.zh: 她从容不迫地应对了那些刁钻问题，仿佛拥有世间所有的余裕。

examples.en: His effortless ease in social situations makes people feel comfortable around him.
examples.zh: 他在社交场合中那种不费力的松弛感，让周围的人都感到舒服。

entries.translation: waking up on the wrong side
entries.shortAnswer: 「起床气」的英文是 waking up on the wrong side，指醒来后莫名烦躁易怒。
entries.definition: 中文「起床气」把情绪说成名词化的「气」，英文用方位隐喻，指从床的错误一侧醒来，暗指一天不顺。

examples.en: Don't take it personally—he is just waking up on the wrong side this morning.
examples.zh: 别往心里去，他今天早上只是有起床气。

examples.en: I think I'm waking up on the wrong side today; everything is getting on my nerves.
examples.zh: 我觉得我今天有起床气，什么事都让我心烦。

entries.term: waking up on the wrong side
entries.shortAnswer: waking up on the wrong side means 起床气—grumpy right after getting up.
entries.definition: waking up on the wrong side means being irritable after waking for no clear reason. Use it for a passing mood.

examples.en: Don't take it personally—he is just waking up on the wrong side this morning.
examples.zh: 别往心里去，他今天早上只是有起床气。

examples.en: I think I'm waking up on the wrong side today; everything is getting on my nerves.
examples.zh: 我觉得我今天有起床气，什么事都让我心烦。

entries.shortAnswer: 「假期综合征」用英语说是 post-holiday blues，指假期后回归工作或学习时出现的疲惫低落。
entries.definition: 常搭配 get/have/suffer from post-holiday blues，指长假或周末后几天提不起劲；持续数周并影响生活就不宜再这样说了。

examples.en: I always get the post-holiday blues on the first Monday back at work.
examples.zh: 每次假期结束回去上班的第一个周一，我总会犯假期综合征。

examples.en: She tried to beat the post-holiday blues by planning a small weekend trip.
examples.zh: 她试着安排一次周末小旅行，来缓解假期综合征。

entries.shortAnswer: post-holiday blues 的中文意思是「假期综合征」，指假期结束后重返日常时感到低落疲惫、不在状态。
entries.definition: 口语和非正式说法，搭配 get/have/suffer from post-holiday blues，多指节后几天到一周的情绪低谷，强调短暂可恢复。

examples.en: I always get the post-holiday blues on the first Monday back at work.
examples.zh: 每次假期结束回去上班的第一个周一，我总会犯假期综合征。

examples.en: She tried to beat the post-holiday blues by planning a small weekend trip.
examples.zh: 她试着安排一次周末小旅行，来缓解假期综合征。

entries.shortAnswer: 「佛系」英文说 zen-like detachment，指不争不抢、怎么都行的态度。
entries.definition: zen-like detachment 指对得失淡然、不主动争取也不焦虑。非宗教术语，是网络自嘲表达。

examples.en: After years of chasing promotions, he adopted a zen-like detachment and let things happen.
examples.zh: 在多年追求升职后，他变得佛系，顺其自然。

examples.en: Her zen-like detachment from social media drama makes her seem older than her age.
examples.zh: 她对社交媒体上的闹剧保持佛系，这让她显得比实际年龄成熟。

entries.shortAnswer: Zen-like detachment means 「佛系」: a calm, non-striving, whatever attitude.
entries.definition: A laid-back, unbothered attitude towards competition or outcomes; a pop-culture label, not religious.

examples.en: After years of chasing promotions, he adopted a zen-like detachment and let things happen.
examples.zh: 在多年追求升职后，他变得佛系，顺其自然。

examples.en: Her zen-like detachment from social media drama makes her seem older than her age.
examples.zh: 她对社交媒体上的闹剧保持佛系，这让她显得比实际年龄成熟。

entries.shortAnswer: 「选择困难症」的英文是 decision paralysis，日常也常说 analysis paralysis；这是网络自嘲式说法，并非临床诊断。
entries.definition: 指面对多个选项难以取舍、拖延决策的状态，像「强迫症」「拖延症」一样属于「XX症」自嘲句式。英文常用搭配：suffer from decision paralysis、be paralyzed by choice。

examples.en: I spent twenty minutes staring at the menu and still couldn't order—classic decision paralysis.
examples.zh: 我盯着菜单看了二十分钟还是没点单——典型的「选择困难症」。

examples.en: Too many similar options online can trigger decision paralysis and make you buy nothing at all.
examples.zh: 网上太多相似的选项会引发选择困难症，结果你什么都没买成。

entries.shortAnswer: Decision paralysis 的中文意思是「选择困难症」，指面对太多选项时无法做出决定。与 analysis paralysis 相比，它更强调「选项过多」而非「分析过度」。
entries.definition: 指因选项过多或害怕选错而陷入决策停滞，日常和职场都常用；口语也常说 analysis paralysis。注意它不是正式临床诊断，多用于自嘲或描述状态。

examples.en: I spent twenty minutes staring at the menu and still couldn't order—classic decision paralysis.
examples.zh: 我盯着菜单看了二十分钟还是没点单——典型的「选择困难症」。

examples.en: Too many similar options online can trigger decision paralysis and make you buy nothing at all.
examples.zh: 网上太多相似的选项会引发选择困难症，结果你什么都没买成。

entries.shortAnswer: 「社交恐惧」的英文是 social anxiety，指在社交场合中紧张、害怕被负面评价的情绪。
entries.definition: social anxiety 是名词短语，常搭配 have、experience；也可说 social anxiety disorder。它与 shy 不同：shy 偏性格，social anxiety 强调焦虑，未必是临床诊断。

examples.en: She experiences social anxiety when she has to speak in front of a large group.
examples.zh: 当她必须在一大群人面前讲话时，她会感到社交恐惧。

examples.en: His social anxiety often makes him avoid parties and other social events.
examples.zh: 他的社交恐惧常常让他回避聚会和其他社交活动。

entries.shortAnswer: 「social anxiety」的中文意思是「社交恐惧」，指在社交或表现场合中紧张、害怕被负面评价的情绪。
entries.definition: social anxiety 是名词短语，常见搭配有 have social anxiety、social anxiety disorder。口语中可泛指社交紧张，正式语境可指临床诊断，不宜与 shyness 完全等同。

examples.en: She experiences social anxiety when she has to speak in front of a large group.
examples.zh: 当她必须在一大群人面前讲话时，她会感到社交恐惧。

examples.en: His social anxiety often makes him avoid parties and other social events.
examples.zh: 他的社交恐惧常常让他回避聚会和其他社交活动。

entries.shortAnswer: 「强迫症」的英文可表达为 OCD-like tendencies，指有类似强迫倾向但未必达到临床诊断标准。日常自嘲常用，注意与正式诊断 OCD 区分。
entries.definition: OCD-like tendencies 多用于口语和网络语境，表示爱整齐、反复检查等强迫倾向。不是临床诊断术语，正式诊断用 OCD（强迫症）。

examples.en: I keep rearranging my desk until everything is perfectly aligned—my friends say I have OCD-like tendencies.
examples.zh: 我总要把桌子摆到完全对齐才安心，朋友们说我有强迫症倾向。

examples.en: She checks the door lock three times before leaving, which she jokes are just her OCD-like tendencies.
examples.zh: 她出门前要检查三次门锁，她自嘲说这只是她的强迫症倾向。

entries.shortAnswer: OCD-like tendencies 的中文意思是「强迫症」，但更准确说是「类强迫症倾向」，指有强迫倾向却未必符合临床诊断。它比正式诊断 OCD 更轻、更口语。
entries.definition: OCD-like tendencies 指类似强迫症的行为或思维倾向，常见搭配有 have/show OCD-like tendencies。多用于日常自嘲或非正式描述，正式医学语境应说 OCD。

examples.en: I keep rearranging my desk until everything is perfectly aligned—my friends say I have OCD-like tendencies.
examples.zh: 我总要把桌子摆到完全对齐才安心，朋友们说我有强迫症倾向。

examples.en: She checks the door lock three times before leaving, which she jokes are just her OCD-like tendencies.
examples.zh: 她出门前要检查三次门锁，她自嘲说这只是她的强迫症倾向。

entries.shortAnswer: 密集恐惧症英文常写作 fear of clustered holes，口语也说 trypophobia；注意它不是正式诊断，多指看到密集孔洞时的恶心、发麻等不适感。
entries.definition: fear of clustered holes 是描述性说法，trypophobia 更学术。常用于网络自嘲，如「我密集恐惧症犯了」；不等于临床恐惧症，别用于正式诊断。

examples.en: I have a fear of clustered holes, so that lotus seed pod picture really makes my skin crawl.
examples.zh: 我有密集恐惧症，所以那张莲蓬图片真的让我起鸡皮疙瘩。

examples.en: Her fear of clustered holes is mostly a joke online, but she still avoids looking at honeycomb patterns.
examples.zh: 她的密集恐惧症在网上多半是自嘲，但她还是不敢看蜂窝图案。

entries.shortAnswer: Fear of clustered holes 的中文意思是密集恐惧症，也叫 trypophobia；它多指对密集孔洞图案的厌恶或发麻感，并非严格临床诊断。
entries.definition: fear of clustered holes 是口语/描述性表达，trypophobia 更正式。常搭配 have/trigger a fear of clustered holes，用于网络自嘲或科普语境。

entries.shortAnswer: 「认生」的英文是 shy with strangers，指小孩怕见生人、只认熟人。注意别和 shy（泛指害羞）混用，认生特指对陌生人的警惕，常出现在婴幼儿发育话题里。
entries.definition: 认生形容婴儿或幼儿见到陌生人就哭闹、躲避，只肯让熟人抱。英文常用 shy with strangers，也可说 slow to warm up。与 shy 不同：shy 是性格害羞，认生是阶段性的陌生人焦虑。

examples.en: Don't worry, she's just shy with strangers and needs a few minutes to warm up.
examples.zh: 别担心，她只是认生，需要几分钟才能熟络起来。

examples.en: Our baby used to be shy with strangers, but now she smiles at everyone.
examples.zh: 我们家宝宝以前很认生，现在见谁都笑。

entries.shortAnswer: shy with strangers 的中文意思是「认生」，即小孩见到生人就害怕、只认熟人。它比 shy 更具体，特指对陌生人的警惕，是婴幼儿发育中的常见阶段。
entries.definition: shy with strangers 形容幼儿见生人哭闹躲避，只认熟人，中文叫认生。口语常用，也可说 slow to warm up。注意它不等于 shy（泛指害羞），不用于成人社交恐惧。

examples.en: Don't worry, she's just shy with strangers and needs a few minutes to warm up.
examples.zh: 别担心，她只是认生，需要几分钟才能熟络起来。

examples.en: Our baby used to be shy with strangers, but now she smiles at everyone.
examples.zh: 我们家宝宝以前很认生，现在见谁都笑。

entries.shortAnswer: 「脸盲」用英语说是 face blindness。日常多为自嘲式表达，指记不住或认不出人脸，不等于医学上的“面容失认症”。
entries.definition: 常见搭配：have face blindness、suffer from face blindness。日常口语里常自嘲“我脸盲”，并非临床诊断；医学正式术语为 prosopagnosia。

examples.en: I have face blindness, so I often fail to recognize my classmates outside of class.
examples.zh: 我脸盲，所以课后常常认不出同学。

examples.en: Her face blindness makes it hard for her to follow shows with large casts.
examples.zh: 她脸盲，所以很难看懂演员多的剧。

entries.shortAnswer: Face blindness 的中文意思是「脸盲」，指认不出或记不住人脸。日常多是自嘲说法，医学正式病名为 prosopagnosia。
entries.definition: 不可数名词，常见搭配 have/suffer from face blindness。非正式场合可轻松自嘲；医学语境指面容失认症，需与 prosopagnosia 区分。

examples.en: I have face blindness, so I often fail to recognize my classmates outside of class.
examples.zh: 我脸盲，所以课后常常认不出同学。

examples.en: Her face blindness makes it hard for her to follow shows with large casts.
examples.zh: 她脸盲，所以很难看懂演员多的剧。

entries.shortAnswer: 「认床」英文是 trouble sleeping in new beds，指换床就睡不好，只认自己的床。
entries.definition: 认床指睡眠环境依赖：换床、住酒店就容易失眠。口语常说 I have trouble sleeping in new beds，别直译 recognize bed。

examples.en: I always have trouble sleeping in new beds, so I bring my own pillow when I travel.
examples.zh: 我认床，所以旅行时都自带枕头。

examples.en: She had trouble sleeping in new beds at first, but after a few nights in the hotel she felt fine.
examples.zh: 她起初认床，但在酒店住了几晚后就适应了。

entries.shortAnswer: trouble sleeping in new beds 意思是「认床」，即换了陌生的床就睡不好。
entries.definition: trouble sleeping in new beds 描述因睡眠环境改变而入睡困难，程度可轻可重，非临床诊断，回到自己床上通常就好。

examples.en: I always have trouble sleeping in new beds, so I bring my own pillow when I travel.
examples.zh: 我认床，所以旅行时都自带枕头。

examples.en: She had trouble sleeping in new beds at first, but after a few nights in the hotel she felt fine.
examples.zh: 她起初认床，但在酒店住了几晚后就适应了。

entries.shortAnswer: 「下头」的英文是 turn-off moment，指瞬间失去兴趣或好感。注意「下头」是瞬间反应，不是长期讨厌；反义词是「上头」，即上头式的迷恋。
entries.definition: 「下头」是「上头」的反义：上头指因某细节突然极度喜欢、像上瘾一样；下头指因对方一句话或一个动作瞬间好感清零，常用于追星、暧昧、恋爱场景。英文常用 turn-off 或 turn-off moment。

examples.en: He kept checking his phone during our date, and that was a total turn-off moment for me.
examples.zh: 他约会时一直看手机，那一刻我彻底下头了。

examples.en: Her constant bragging about her ex turned into a turn-off moment that killed my crush instantly.
examples.zh: 她不停炫耀前任，那个瞬间让我下头，好感全无。

entries.shortAnswer: Turn-off moment 的中文是「下头」，指某个瞬间突然失去兴趣或好感。它强调瞬间的倒胃口，不是长期讨厌；反义是「上头」，即上瘾式喜欢。
entries.definition: Turn-off moment 指某个具体言行让人瞬间兴致全无，口语常用。turn-off 可作名词，如 That's a turn-off；moment 强调瞬间性。与 disgust 不同，它多指吸引力骤降而非道德厌恶。

examples.en: He kept checking his phone during our date, and that was a total turn-off moment for me.
examples.zh: 他约会时一直看手机，那一刻我彻底下头了。

examples.en: Her constant bragging about her ex turned into a turn-off moment that killed my crush instantly.
examples.zh: 她不停炫耀前任，那个瞬间让我下头，好感全无。

entries.shortAnswer: 「路痴」的英文是 terrible sense of direction，形容方向感极差、容易迷路。
entries.definition: 「路痴」指方向感差、常迷路的人。英文说 have a terrible sense of direction，也可说 no sense of direction，语气更重。

examples.en: I have a terrible sense of direction, so I use maps even for short walks.
examples.zh: 我是个路痴，所以哪怕走很短的路也要用地图。

examples.en: She joked that her terrible sense of direction made her late again.
examples.zh: 她开玩笑说，自己的路痴又让她迟到了。

entries.shortAnswer: terrible sense of direction 就是中文说的「路痴」，指方向感差、容易迷路。
entries.definition: 指方向感很差、常迷路。常用 have a terrible sense of direction，语气中性偏自嘲，口语书面皆可。

examples.en: I have a terrible sense of direction, so I use maps even for short walks.
examples.zh: 我是个路痴，所以哪怕走很短的路也要用地图。

examples.en: She joked that her terrible sense of direction made her late again.
examples.zh: 她开玩笑说，自己的路痴又让她迟到了。

entries.translation: faint at the sight of blood
entries.shortAnswer: 「晕血」的英文是 faint at the sight of blood，指见血就头晕甚至昏厥。
entries.definition: 「晕血」英文常说 faint at the sight of blood，指见血后出现生理性昏厥，而非单纯怕血。

examples.en: I can't watch medical dramas because I faint at the sight of blood.
examples.zh: 我没法看医疗剧，因为我晕血。

examples.en: She warned the nurse that she might faint at the sight of blood during the injection.
examples.zh: 她提前告诉护士，打针时她可能会晕血。

entries.term: faint at the sight of blood
entries.shortAnswer: faint at the sight of blood 的中文意思是「晕血」，即看到血就头晕甚至昏倒。
entries.definition: faint at the sight of blood 意为「晕血」，指见到血液、伤口或打针时出现血管迷走性昏厥。

examples.en: I can't watch medical dramas because I faint at the sight of blood.
examples.zh: 我没法看医疗剧，因为我晕血。

examples.en: She warned the nurse that she might faint at the sight of blood during the injection.
examples.zh: 她提前告诉护士，打针时她可能会晕血。

entries.shortAnswer: 「意难平」的英文是 lingering regret，指事已过去却仍心绪难平、余情未了。
entries.definition: lingering regret 指挥之不去的遗憾，常搭配 leave sb with a lingering regret，语气偏文学化，不同于怨恨。

examples.en: Watching the finale, I was left with a lingering regret for the couple who never got their happy ending.
examples.zh: 看完大结局，那对没能迎来圆满结局的恋人让我意难平。

examples.en: Years later, he still had a lingering regret about the words he never said to his father.
examples.zh: 多年以后，他仍对没来得及对父亲说出口的话意难平。

entries.shortAnswer: Lingering regret is the English for 「意难平」: a regret that will not fade after the event.
entries.definition: A lingering regret is a sad feeling about the past that stays with you long after. Not a clinical term; for real resentment say bitterness.

examples.en: Watching the finale, I was left with a lingering regret for the couple who never got their happy ending.
examples.zh: 看完大结局，那对没能迎来圆满结局的恋人让我意难平。

examples.en: Years later, he still had a lingering regret about the words he never said to his father.
examples.zh: 多年以后，他仍对没来得及对父亲说出口的话意难平。

entries.shortAnswer: 公积金 的英文是 housing provident fund。它指中国强制性的住房公积金制度，常用于工资条和劳动合同中，注意与 401k 或普通养老金区分。
entries.definition: 公积金即住房公积金，由单位和个人按同比例缴存，用于购房、租房等住房消费，可申请低息贷款。英文固定说法为 housing provident fund，不要译成 pension 或 401k，后者是养老制度。

examples.en: My new employer matches my housing provident fund contribution every month, which helps me save for an apartment.
examples.zh: 我的新公司每个月按同等比例为我缴存公积金，这帮我攒钱买房。

examples.en: Before signing the contract, she asked HR whether the housing provident fund was included in the salary package.
examples.zh: 签合同前，她问人力资源公积金是否包含在薪酬方案里。

entries.shortAnswer: Housing provident fund 的中文是 公积金。它是中国特有的强制住房储蓄制度，不是养老金，常出现在工资单和录用通知里。
entries.definition: Housing provident fund 指中国住房公积金，由雇主和雇员等比例缴存，可用于买房、还贷或租房。正式场合用全称，口语可说 provident fund，但不要与 pension 或 401k 混用。

examples.en: My new employer matches my housing provident fund contribution every month, which helps me save for an apartment.
examples.zh: 我的新公司每个月按同等比例为我缴存公积金，这帮我攒钱买房。

examples.en: Before signing the contract, she asked HR whether the housing provident fund was included in the salary package.
examples.zh: 签合同前，她问人力资源公积金是否包含在薪酬方案里。

entries.shortAnswer: 「如释重负」的英文是 a weight lifted off the chest，像卸下心头大石，常与 feel 搭配。
entries.definition: 如释重负强调紧张、焦虑或担忧消除后的轻松感。常见搭配：feel a weight lifted off the chest、a huge weight lifted off my chest。非临床焦虑症诊断用语。

examples.en: When the exam results came out and I had passed, I felt a huge weight lifted off the chest.
examples.zh: 考试成绩出来、我通过的那一刻，我感到如释重负。

examples.en: Telling her the truth was hard, but afterwards it was like a weight lifted off the chest.
examples.zh: 告诉她真相很难，但说完之后我如释重负。

entries.shortAnswer: A weight lifted off the chest 意为「如释重负」，指担忧或压力消失后的放松感。
entries.definition: a weight lifted off the chest 表示心头重担卸下，强调情绪瞬间的轻松。口语常说 a huge weight lifted off my chest；正式书面也可用，但不是临床诊断术语。

examples.en: When the exam results came out and I had passed, I felt a huge weight lifted off the chest.
examples.zh: 考试成绩出来、我通过的那一刻，我感到如释重负。

examples.en: Telling her the truth was hard, but afterwards it was like a weight lifted off the chest.
examples.zh: 告诉她真相很难，但说完之后我如释重负。

entries.shortAnswer: 「转正」的英文是 pass probation，常用于通过试用期后正式入职。别直译成 become regular，正式职场用 pass probation 更地道。
entries.definition: pass probation 指试用期考核合格、转为正式员工。搭配有 pass one's probation、be on probation。注意：probation 也用于缓刑、观察期，职场语境靠上下文判断。

examples.en: After three months, she finally passed probation and got her full benefits.
examples.zh: 三个月后，她终于转正了，开始享受完整福利。

examples.en: If you pass probation, the company will sign a formal labor contract with you.
examples.zh: 如果你转正，公司会和你签正式劳动合同。

entries.shortAnswer: pass probation 的中文意思是「转正」，即顺利通过试用期成为正式员工。与 be hired 不同，它强调试用期满且考核通过。
entries.definition: pass probation 指顺利完成试用期并转为正式职位。常见搭配 pass one's probation、be on probation。正式书面和日常口语都可用；易错点是误用为 get regular，后者不地道。

examples.en: After three months, she finally passed probation and got her full benefits.
examples.zh: 三个月后，她终于转正了，开始享受完整福利。

examples.en: If you pass probation, the company will sign a formal labor contract with you.
examples.zh: 如果你转正，公司会和你签正式劳动合同。

entries.shortAnswer: 「被优化」的英文是 euphemism for getting laid off，即用「优化」来委婉表达被裁员。
entries.definition: 「被优化」是中国职场中「裁员」的委婉说法，字面意思是「被改进得更好」，实指因公司调整而失去职位。英文对应委婉语有 let go、downsized。

examples.en: The company announced a new round of restructuring, but everyone knew it was a euphemism for getting laid off.
examples.zh: 公司宣布了新一轮架构调整，但大家都知道这是「被优化」的委婉说法。

examples.en: When HR says your position has been eliminated, it's just a euphemism for getting laid off.
examples.zh: 当人力资源说你的岗位被取消时，那只是「被优化」的委婉表达。

entries.shortAnswer: “euphemism for getting laid off”的中文是「被优化」，即用「优化」来委婉表达被裁员。
entries.definition: euphemism for getting laid off 指用「被优化」等委婉语代替直接说「被裁员」。英文中类似说法有 let go、downsized、made redundant。

examples.en: The company announced a new round of restructuring, but everyone knew it was a euphemism for getting laid off.
examples.zh: 公司宣布了新一轮架构调整，但大家都知道这是「被优化」的委婉说法。

examples.en: When HR says your position has been eliminated, it's just a euphemism for getting laid off.
examples.zh: 当人力资源说你的岗位被取消时，那只是「被优化」的委婉表达。

entries.shortAnswer: 「骑驴找马」的英文是 job-hunt while employed，指在职期间找新工作，不裸辞先找好下家。
entries.definition: 用法：多作动词短语，如 be job-hunting while employed。搭配：secretly job-hunt while employed（暗地骑驴找马）。易错点：别直译 ride donkey find horse。

examples.en: She decided to job-hunt while employed so she wouldn't have a gap in her income.
examples.zh: 她决定骑驴找马，这样收入就不会断档。

examples.en: Many professionals job-hunt while employed, quietly attending interviews after work.
examples.zh: 许多职场人骑驴找马，下班后悄悄去面试。

entries.shortAnswer: “job-hunt while employed”的中文意思是「骑驴找马」，即不辞职就找下一份工作。
entries.definition: 核心义：在职求职，先保住现有收入再找下家。常见搭配：be job-hunting while employed；正式可用 pursue opportunities while employed。

examples.en: She decided to job-hunt while employed so she wouldn't have a gap in her income.
examples.zh: 她决定骑驴找马，这样收入就不会断档。

examples.en: Many professionals job-hunt while employed, quietly attending interviews after work.
examples.zh: 许多职场人骑驴找马，下班后悄悄去面试。

entries.shortAnswer: 「调薪」最常用的英文是 salary adjustment，正式指公司对薪资的调整，可涨可降，口语 pay raise 多只指加薪。
entries.definition: salary adjustment 是职场正式说法，指对薪资的调整，常见于年度调薪、绩效调薪等，可能加薪也可能降薪或平调，不等于升职。

examples.en: After the performance review, the company announced a salary adjustment for all employees.
examples.zh: 绩效评估之后，公司宣布对全体员工进行调薪。

examples.en: She requested a salary adjustment because her duties had grown a lot.
examples.zh: 她申请调薪，因为她的职责增加了不少。

entries.shortAnswer: salary adjustment 的中文就是「调薪」，指公司对员工薪资的正式调整，可加薪、降薪或平调，比 pay raise 更中性。
entries.definition: salary adjustment 是正式职场用语，指对基本工资的调整，常见搭配有年度调薪、绩效调薪，可涵盖加薪、降薪或薪酬体系改革。

examples.en: After the performance review, the company announced a salary adjustment for all employees.
examples.zh: 绩效评估之后，公司宣布对全体员工进行调薪。

examples.en: She requested a salary adjustment because her duties had grown a lot.
examples.zh: 她申请调薪，因为她的职责增加了不少。

entries.shortAnswer: 「隐形加班」英文是 invisible overtime，指下班后在线干活却不计工时、不给钱。
entries.definition: invisible overtime 指未记录、不被承认的加班，常搭配 do/put in invisible overtime。

examples.en: Replying to WeChat messages after 10 p.m. is invisible overtime—your boss sees it, but your timesheet doesn't.
examples.zh: 晚上十点后回复微信消息就是隐形加班——老板看得见，但考勤表上看不见。

examples.en: The 2024 Two Sessions discussed whether invisible overtime should be paid like regular overtime.
examples.zh: 2024年两会讨论了隐形加班是否应像正常加班一样获得报酬。

entries.shortAnswer: Invisible overtime means 隐形加班: unpaid after-hours work done online, not counted or paid.
entries.definition: Invisible overtime is off-the-clock work. Collocations: do/put in invisible overtime; contrast visible overtime.

examples.en: Replying to WeChat messages after 10 p.m. is invisible overtime—your boss sees it, but your timesheet doesn't.
examples.zh: 晚上十点后回复微信消息就是隐形加班——老板看得见，但考勤表上看不见。

examples.en: The 2024 Two Sessions discussed whether invisible overtime should be paid like regular overtime.
examples.zh: 2024年两会讨论了隐形加班是否应像正常加班一样获得报酬。

entries.shortAnswer: 汇报线用英语说是 reporting line，指你在组织架构里向谁汇报、归谁管的层级关系。注意它是一条上下级的线，不是平级协作关系。
entries.definition: 固定搭配为 someone's reporting line，常见说法有 change/alter the reporting line。隐含层级隐喻：你在这条线上向上汇报，线不断则隶属关系不断；虚线（dotted line）则指间接或项目性汇报。

examples.en: After the merger, my reporting line changed, and I now report directly to the regional director.
examples.zh: 合并之后，我的汇报线变了，现在直接向区域总监汇报。

examples.en: The org chart shows a clear reporting line from the new hires up to the department head.
examples.zh: 组织架构图清晰地标出了新员工向部门负责人汇报的层级关系。

entries.shortAnswer: reporting line 的中文意思是汇报线，指员工在组织中向上汇报的层级关系。它强调的是正式上下级的隶属链条，而非日常协作或沟通关系。
entries.definition: a reporting line 是名词短语，多用于 HR、组织架构和职场正式场合，如 someone's reporting line to someone。易错点：不要与 dotted line（虚线汇报）混用，后者指非正式的间接汇报关系。

examples.en: After the merger, my reporting line changed, and I now report directly to the regional director.
examples.zh: 合并之后，我的汇报线变了，现在直接向区域总监汇报。

examples.en: The org chart shows a clear reporting line from the new hires up to the department head.
examples.zh: 组织架构图清晰地标出了新员工向部门负责人汇报的层级关系。

entries.shortAnswer: 「日报周报」英文是 daily and weekly reports，指按日、周提交的工作汇报，职场常说 daily/weekly report。
entries.definition: 常用搭配：write/submit/send daily and weekly reports。日报给直属领导，周报汇总进度、问题与下周计划，口语可省略 reports。

examples.en: My manager expects daily and weekly reports to track progress, so I usually spend Friday afternoon summarizing what I have done.
examples.zh: 我的主管要求提交日报周报来跟踪进度，所以我通常周五下午总结已完成的工作。

examples.en: Writing daily and weekly reports may feel repetitive, but they help the team align on priorities and spot roadblocks early.
examples.zh: 写日报周报可能显得重复，但它们能帮助团队对齐优先级并及早发现阻碍。

entries.shortAnswer: Daily and weekly reports 意思是「日报周报」，即每天和每周提交的例行工作汇报，常见于职场考核。
entries.definition: 核心词义：按日、周提交的例行工作汇报，常与 write/submit/send 搭配。易错点：daily 和 weekly 分别指日报与周报，不可互换。

examples.en: My manager expects daily and weekly reports to track progress, so I usually spend Friday afternoon summarizing what I have done.
examples.zh: 我的主管要求提交日报周报来跟踪进度，所以我通常周五下午总结已完成的工作。

examples.en: Writing daily and weekly reports may feel repetitive, but they help the team align on priorities and spot roadblocks early.
examples.zh: 写日报周报可能显得重复，但它们能帮助团队对齐优先级并及早发现阻碍。

entries.shortAnswer: N+1赔偿英文写作 N+1 severance pay，中国裁员常见补偿方式，N 为工龄补偿月数，1 为代通知金。
entries.definition: N+1赔偿即 N+1 severance pay，N 按工龄折算补偿月数，1 为代通知金，是中国劳动法下常见的裁员补偿方案。

examples.en: After the layoff, she received N+1 severance pay under Chinese labor law.
examples.zh: 裁员之后，她按中国劳动法拿到了 N+1 赔偿。

examples.en: He asked HR whether the package was N+1 severance pay before signing.
examples.zh: 签字之前，他问人事，方案是不是 N+1 赔偿。

entries.shortAnswer: N+1 severance pay 中文叫 N+1赔偿，指中国劳动法下裁员常见补偿，含工龄补偿与代通知金。
entries.definition: N+1 severance pay 中文即 N+1赔偿：N 为按工龄折算的补偿月数，1 为代通知金，常见搭配 get N+1 severance pay。

examples.en: After the layoff, she received N+1 severance pay under Chinese labor law.
examples.zh: 裁员之后，她按中国劳动法拿到了 N+1 赔偿。

examples.en: He asked HR whether the package was N+1 severance pay before signing.
examples.zh: 签字之前，他问人事，方案是不是 N+1 赔偿。

entries.shortAnswer: 「拉通对齐」的英文是 align across teams。它源自互联网黑话：拉通指跨部门打通信息，对齐指达成共识，常出现在会议与项目排期语境。
entries.definition: align across teams 强调跨团队同步信息并形成一致结论，比简单的 agree 更侧重流程与协作。常见搭配：align with stakeholders、get everyone on the same page。批评视角下，它常被用来包装冗长无效的会议。

examples.en: Before we start development, we need to align across teams on the scope and timeline.
examples.zh: 在开始开发之前，我们需要就范围和时间线拉通对齐。

examples.en: The meeting was supposed to align across teams, but it ended without any clear decision.
examples.zh: 这场会议本意是拉通对齐，但开完也没得出明确结论。

entries.shortAnswer: align across teams 的中文意思是「拉通对齐」。它指跨部门打通信息、让各方达成共识，语义重点在协同与同步，而非单纯的同意或说服。
entries.definition: align across teams 指让不同团队在目标、信息与节奏上保持一致；常见的口语说法是 get everyone on the same page。多用于职场与项目管理，偏正式，语气中性，但过度使用会被视为空话。

examples.en: Before we start development, we need to align across teams on the scope and timeline.
examples.zh: 在开始开发之前，我们需要就范围和时间线拉通对齐。

examples.en: The meeting was supposed to align across teams, but it ended without any clear decision.
examples.zh: 这场会议本意是拉通对齐，但开完也没得出明确结论。

entries.shortAnswer: 颗粒度的英文是 granularity，原指图像或材料的精细程度。职场黑话中常借它表示把问题拆解到多细，如“提高颗粒度”即更细致地分析。
entries.definition: 颗粒度在互联网职场中常指分析或管理的细致程度，搭配如“细化颗粒度”“颗粒度太粗”。注意它借自图像学术语 granularity，并非中文固有词汇，但英文完全对应。

examples.en: Let's increase the granularity of our user feedback analysis to identify specific pain points.
examples.zh: 让我们提高用户反馈分析的颗粒度，以便找出具体的痛点。

examples.en: The data granularity in this report is too coarse for making strategic decisions.
examples.zh: 这份报告的数据颗粒度太粗，无法用于制定战略决策。

entries.shortAnswer: granularity 的中文意思是颗粒度，原为图像或材料学术语。在职场语境中，它指把问题拆解到多细，如“提高颗粒度”即更细致地分析。
entries.definition: granularity 指细节的精细程度，正式场合用于图像、数据等领域；职场黑话中常与 increase、improve 等动词搭配，表示细化分析。注意其与 detail 不同，强调拆解层级。

examples.en: Let's increase the granularity of our user feedback analysis to identify specific pain points.
examples.zh: 让我们提高用户反馈分析的颗粒度，以便找出具体的痛点。

examples.en: The data granularity in this report is too coarse for making strategic decisions.
examples.zh: 这份报告的数据颗粒度太粗，无法用于制定战略决策。

entries.shortAnswer: 「抓手」常译为 lever point，指工作的切入点和着力点。它是互联网黑话，源自“执物之手”，英文中 handle 更形象，但 lever point 更常指战略支点。
entries.definition: “抓手”在职场中虚化为可操作的具体措施或着力点，常搭配“找抓手”“工作抓手”。英文 lever point 强调杠杆支点，entry point 指切入点，handle 指把手。注意：不要直译为 hand grab。

examples.en: We need to identify a clear lever point to drive this project forward.
examples.zh: 我们需要找到一个明确的抓手来推动这个项目。

examples.en: The new policy serves as a lever point for improving cross-department collaboration.
examples.zh: 新政策是改善跨部门协作的一个抓手。

entries.shortAnswer: lever point 中文常译作「抓手」，指工作的切入点和着力点。它源自物理杠杆的支点，但在职场黑话中常虚化为可操作的具体措施，与 handle（把手）不同。
entries.definition: lever point 在商务语境中指战略或行动的支点，常见搭配 find a lever point, key lever point。较正式，口语中可用 handle 替代。易错点：它不是“杠杆点”的字面物理义，而是比喻义。

examples.en: We need to identify a clear lever point to drive this project forward.
examples.zh: 我们需要找到一个明确的抓手来推动这个项目。

examples.en: The new policy serves as a lever point for improving cross-department collaboration.
examples.zh: 新政策是改善跨部门协作的一个抓手。

entries.shortAnswer: 「跨部门协作」的英文是 cross-team collaboration，指不同团队为共同目标一起工作。
entries.definition: cross-team collaboration 指多个团队打破壁垒、共同决策与执行；常见搭配 promote cross-team collaboration。

examples.en: The new project requires cross-team collaboration between marketing, engineering, and sales to meet the tight deadline.
examples.zh: 这个新项目需要市场、工程和销售部门跨部门协作，才能赶上紧迫的截止日期。

examples.en: Our manager often emphasizes that cross-team collaboration is key to breaking down silos and driving innovation.
examples.zh: 我们的经理经常强调，跨部门协作是打破部门壁垒、推动创新的关键。

entries.shortAnswer: cross-team collaboration 就是「跨部门协作」，指不同团队为共同目标合作。
entries.definition: cross-team collaboration means different teams working together toward shared goals; common in business contexts.

examples.en: The new project requires cross-team collaboration between marketing, engineering, and sales to meet the tight deadline.
examples.zh: 这个新项目需要市场、工程和销售部门跨部门协作，才能赶上紧迫的截止日期。

examples.en: Our manager often emphasizes that cross-team collaboration is key to breaking down silos and driving innovation.
examples.zh: 我们的经理经常强调，跨部门协作是打破部门壁垒、推动创新的关键。

entries.shortAnswer: 「赋能」的英文是 empower，名词形式为 empowerment，是互联网黑话里最常被滥用的词之一。
entries.definition: empower 本义为「授权、使有能力」，中文「赋能」直接对译，但互联网语境常把它夸大成万能动词。

examples.en: The new platform is designed to empower small businesses to sell online without technical barriers.
examples.zh: 这个新平台旨在为小微企业赋能，让它们无需技术门槛就能在线销售。

examples.en: Good managers empower their teams instead of micromanaging every task.
examples.zh: 好的管理者会为团队赋能，而不是对每项任务都微观管理。

entries.shortAnswer: empower 的中文意思是「赋能」，也可译作「授权、使有能力」，比 enable 更强调把权力或能力真正交给对方。
entries.definition: empower 指 give someone power or authority，或 make someone more confident and capable，商务与社科语境高频。

examples.en: The new platform is designed to empower small businesses to sell online without technical barriers.
examples.zh: 这个新平台旨在为小微企业赋能，让它们无需技术门槛就能在线销售。

examples.en: Good managers empower their teams instead of micromanaging every task.
examples.zh: 好的管理者会为团队赋能，而不是对每项任务都微观管理。

entries.shortAnswer: 「占坑」英文是 hold a position，指占住职位或名额不挪窝，职场与论坛预约都常用。
entries.definition: 职场指新人占岗防替换，或老人不离职不放权；论坛指抢先锁定楼层。搭配：hold a position for someone。注意与「踩坑」「填坑」区分。

examples.en: He's been holding a position in the department for years without any real output, just occupying the headcount.
examples.zh: 他在部门里占坑多年，没有实际产出，只是占着编制。

examples.en: She quickly held a position in the forum thread to save a spot for her detailed reply later.
examples.zh: 她在论坛帖子里迅速占坑，为之后的长篇回复留个位置。

entries.shortAnswer: Hold a position 的中文是「占坑」，即占住职位或名额不放手，常带占位不干活的贬义。
entries.definition: 1) 保留职位或名额：She holds a position on the board. 2) 排队占位：hold a spot。职场暗指占坑不拉屎；论坛占坑也用它。hold the position 则指坚守阵地。

examples.en: He's been holding a position in the department for years without any real output, just occupying the headcount.
examples.zh: 他在部门里占坑多年，没有实际产出，只是占着编制。

examples.en: She quickly held a position in the forum thread to save a spot for her detailed reply later.
examples.zh: 她在论坛帖子里迅速占坑，为之后的长篇回复留个位置。

entries.shortAnswer: 「顶班」英文是 cover someone's shift，指临时替别人上他那一次班，只替一次，不等于长期顶岗。
entries.definition: 「顶班」指临时替别人上一次班，常用 cover a shift、cover for someone，名词 shift cover 较少见；它只替一次，不等于长期顶岗。

examples.en: I have a doctor's appointment tomorrow, so could you cover my shift?
examples.zh: 我明天要去看医生，你能帮我顶班吗？

examples.en: She covered someone's shift last night and didn't get home until midnight.
examples.zh: 她昨晚替人顶班，直到半夜才回家。

entries.shortAnswer: cover someone's shift 的中文是「顶班」，即临时替别人上他那一班，只替一次，不等于长期顶岗。
entries.definition: cover someone's shift means to take over another person's work shift temporarily, usually just once, not to fill a permanent post long-term.

examples.en: I have a doctor's appointment tomorrow, so could you cover my shift?
examples.zh: 我明天要去看医生，你能帮我顶班吗？

examples.en: She covered someone's shift last night and didn't get home until midnight.
examples.zh: 她昨晚替人顶班，直到半夜才回家。

entries.shortAnswer: 倒排工期的英文是 work backward from deadline，指从截止日反推排期。
entries.definition: 倒排工期指先定最终交付日，再从截止日反推各阶段起止时间。注意它是逆向规划，并非正向推进或单纯倒计时。

examples.en: The manager chose to work backward from deadline to set clear milestones.
examples.zh: 经理选择倒排工期，以便设定清晰的里程碑。

examples.en: If we work backward from deadline, testing must start next week.
examples.zh: 如果我们倒排工期，下周就必须开始测试。

entries.shortAnswer: 倒排工期 in English is work backward from deadline, scheduling in reverse from the due date.
entries.definition: 倒排工期 means work backward from deadline: set the final due date first, then plan each step backward. It is reverse planning, not a countdown.

examples.en: The manager chose to work backward from deadline to set clear milestones.
examples.zh: 经理选择倒排工期，以便设定清晰的里程碑。

examples.en: If we work backward from deadline, testing must start next week.
examples.zh: 如果我们倒排工期，下周就必须开始测试。

entries.shortAnswer: 职场黑话「沉淀」对应英文 distill and document，指把经验方法系统留存。
entries.definition: 职场借用「沉淀」的析出精华义，指把隐性经验提炼成可复用方法并文档化，如沉淀方法论与标准流程，便于传承。

examples.en: After the project wrapped up, the team held a retrospective to distill and document what worked and what didn't.
examples.zh: 项目结束后，团队开了复盘会，把哪些做得好、哪些没做好沉淀下来。

examples.en: We need to distill and document our growth playbook so new hires can ramp up faster.
examples.zh: 我们需要把增长方法论沉淀成文档，让新人能更快上手。

entries.shortAnswer: In workplace slang, 沉淀 means distill and document: preserving know-how systematically.
entries.definition: Distill and document is corporate jargon for turning tacit know-how into reusable, documented assets like playbooks and SOPs.

examples.en: After the project wrapped up, the team held a retrospective to distill and document what worked and what didn't.
examples.zh: 项目结束后，团队开了复盘会，把哪些做得好、哪些没做好沉淀下来。

examples.en: We need to distill and document our growth playbook so new hires can ramp up faster.
examples.zh: 我们需要把增长方法论沉淀成文档，让新人能更快上手。

entries.shortAnswer: 「员工福利」的英文是 employee benefits，指工资之外的公司待遇。
entries.definition: employee benefits 常用复数，含健康保险、退休计划、带薪假期等。口语常简称 benefits。

examples.en: The company offers competitive employee benefits, including health insurance and a retirement plan.
examples.zh: 该公司提供有竞争力的员工福利，包括健康保险和退休计划。

examples.en: When comparing job offers, don't just look at salary; employee benefits like paid time off and housing fund matter too.
examples.zh: 比较工作机会时，不要只看薪资；带薪休假和公积金等员工福利也很重要。

entries.shortAnswer: employee benefits 的中文是「员工福利」，指雇主在工资外给的待遇。
entries.definition: employee benefits 是正式商务用语，常搭配 competitive employee benefits 或 benefits package。

examples.en: The company offers competitive employee benefits, including health insurance and a retirement plan.
examples.zh: 该公司提供有竞争力的员工福利，包括健康保险和退休计划。

examples.en: When comparing job offers, don't just look at salary; employee benefits like paid time off and housing fund matter too.
examples.zh: 比较工作机会时，不要只看薪资；带薪休假和公积金等员工福利也很重要。

entries.shortAnswer: 「种草」的英语是 get sold on something。它指被内容打动、忍不住想买，强调“被说服”的过程，而非单纯喜欢。
entries.definition: 种草本义是栽种草本，网络义指被推荐激发购买欲。不能直译为 plant grass，常用 get sold on something 或 be influenced to buy。

examples.en: I wasn't planning to buy anything, but after watching that review I got sold on the new earbuds.
examples.zh: 我本来没打算买东西，但看完那篇测评后，我被种草了那款新耳机。

examples.en: She got sold on the idea of a weekend getaway after seeing her friend's photos.
examples.zh: 看到朋友的照片后，她被种草了周末短途旅行这个主意。

entries.shortAnswer: get sold on something 的中文意思是“种草”，即被说服、被打动而产生购买欲。它侧重“被安利成功”的结果，不强调主动喜欢。
entries.definition: get sold on something 为口语短语，指被理由、推荐或内容说服而接受或想买某物。常搭配 on，如 I got sold on it。不是被动语态，易误用成 sell。

examples.en: I wasn't planning to buy anything, but after watching that review I got sold on the new earbuds.
examples.zh: 我本来没打算买东西，但看完那篇测评后，我被种草了那款新耳机。

examples.en: She got sold on the idea of a weekend getaway after seeing her friend's photos.
examples.zh: 看到朋友的照片后，她被种草了周末短途旅行这个主意。

entries.shortAnswer: 满减的英文是 spend-more-save-more deal，指消费满一定金额就减钱，常见于电商与外卖。
entries.definition: 满减是中国电商和外卖的常见促销，英文常说 spend-more-save-more deal 或 spend X get Y off。它靠达到门槛才减钱，和直接降价的折扣不同。常见搭配：满减活动、满减优惠、跨店满减。

examples.en: The store is running a spend-more-save-more deal: spend 200 yuan and get 30 yuan off.
examples.zh: 这家店正在搞满减活动：满两百元减三十元。

examples.en: To hit the spend-more-save-more deal, she added extra snacks to her cart, a trick called coudan in Chinese.
examples.zh: 为了凑满减，她往购物车里加了些零食，中文里这叫“凑单”。

entries.shortAnswer: spend-more-save-more deal 的中文是满减，指消费达到门槛就减钱，常见于中国电商和外卖。
entries.definition: spend-more-save-more deal 指满一定金额减一定金额的促销，口语也可说 spend X get Y off。多用于电商、外卖场景，正式程度中等。易错点：它不等于直接降价的折扣。

examples.en: The store is running a spend-more-save-more deal: spend 200 yuan and get 30 yuan off.
examples.zh: 这家店正在搞满减活动：满两百元减三十元。

examples.en: To hit the spend-more-save-more deal, she added extra snacks to her cart, a trick called coudan in Chinese.
examples.zh: 为了凑满减，她往购物车里加了些零食，中文里这叫“凑单”。

entries.shortAnswer: 「临期食品」的英文是 near-expiry food，指快到保质期、通常打折出售的食品，超市里常有专设的临期食品区。
entries.definition: 常用于超市、电商语境，搭配有 near-expiry food section（临期专区）、buy near-expiry food to save money（买临期食品省钱）。它侧重临近保质期但仍可安全食用，不同于过期食品。

examples.en: Many young people buy near-expiry food to save money and reduce waste.
examples.zh: 许多年轻人购买临期食品，既省钱又减少浪费。

examples.en: The supermarket has a near-expiry food section where everything is half price.
examples.zh: 这家超市设有临期食品专区，所有商品都半价出售。

entries.shortAnswer: 「near-expiry food」的中文意思是「临期食品」，指快到保质期、常打折促销的食品，仍可安全食用。
entries.definition: 英式英语也常用 short-dated products 指临期食品。常见搭配：sell near-expiry food at a discount（临期食品打折卖）、near-expiry food store（临期特卖店）。

examples.en: Many young people buy near-expiry food to save money and reduce waste.
examples.zh: 许多年轻人购买临期食品，既省钱又减少浪费。

examples.en: The supermarket has a near-expiry food section where everything is half price.
examples.zh: 这家超市设有临期食品专区，所有商品都半价出售。

entries.shortAnswer: 「病假条」英文是 sick note，指医生开具证明你因病无法上班的条子，常与 get 连用。
entries.definition: 病假条英文叫 sick note，常与 get、have、need 连用。英式英语中也指学生请假条，美式英语多用 doctor's note。

examples.en: I had to get a sick note from my doctor before my manager would approve the sick leave.
examples.zh: 我得先找医生开病假条，经理才会批准我的病假。

examples.en: HR says any absence over three days requires a sick note, no exceptions.
examples.zh: 人事部说，缺勤超过三天就必须交病假条，没有例外。

entries.shortAnswer: A sick note is a 病假条, a doctor's written proof you are too ill to work or study.
entries.definition: Sick note is common in British English; American English prefers doctor's note. It proves illness, not the time off itself.

examples.en: I had to get a sick note from my doctor before my manager would approve the sick leave.
examples.zh: 我得先找医生开病假条，经理才会批准我的病假。

examples.en: HR says any absence over three days requires a sick note, no exceptions.
examples.zh: 人事部说，缺勤超过三天就必须交病假条，没有例外。

entries.translation: get burned by a bad buy
entries.shortAnswer: 「踩雷」的英文可以说 get burned by a bad buy，指买到不划算或糟糕的东西。它更强调购物后的受骗感或失望感，常用于网购、海淘、团购等消费场景。
entries.definition: get burned by a bad buy 是口语化表达，强调花钱买到差东西后的懊恼，类似「被坑了」；比单纯说 buy the wrong thing 更突出损失和负面情绪。

examples.en: I didn't read the reviews carefully and got burned by a bad buy—the dress looked nothing like the pictures.
examples.zh: 我没仔细看评价就踩雷了，那条裙子跟图片完全不一样。

examples.en: If you always chase limited-time discounts, you might get burned by a bad buy and end up eating dirt.
examples.zh: 如果你总是追限时折扣，就可能踩雷买到烂东西，最后只能吃土。

entries.term: get burned by a bad buy
entries.shortAnswer: “get burned by a bad buy”的中文意思是「踩雷」，通常指买到了质量差、不划算或与宣传不符的东西。它侧重消费后的受骗或失望体验，不等于一般的买错东西。
entries.definition: get burned by a bad buy 常用于非正式口语，核心是“买到烂东西而吃亏”；搭配有 get burned、a bad buy，可指网购、代购、二手交易等；注意 burned 是比喻义，不是真的被火烧。

examples.en: I didn't read the reviews carefully and got burned by a bad buy—the dress looked nothing like the pictures.
examples.zh: 我没仔细看评价就踩雷了，那条裙子跟图片完全不一样。

examples.en: If you always chase limited-time discounts, you might get burned by a bad buy and end up eating dirt.
examples.zh: 如果你总是追限时折扣，就可能踩雷买到烂东西，最后只能吃土。

entries.shortAnswer: 「白嫖」的英文是 enjoy without paying，指享受服务或资源却不付费。在追星语境里，只看不打投也叫白嫖，常含贬义或自嘲，相当于 freeloading。
entries.definition: 白嫖强调「白拿不付费」，如白嫖游戏、白嫖课程；英文常用 freeloading 或 enjoying without paying。它可作贬义指责，也可自嘲省钱。

examples.en: He always tries to enjoy without paying, like using free trials to watch whole seasons.
examples.zh: 他总是想白嫖，比如用免费试用看完整季剧集。

examples.en: Some fans just enjoy without paying, watching clips but never buying albums or voting.
examples.zh: 有些粉丝就是白嫖，只看片段，从不买专辑也不打投。

entries.shortAnswer: 「enjoy without paying」的中文意思是「白嫖」，即不花钱享受资源或服务。与 freeloading 相比，它更口语化，且常带贬义或自嘲语气。
entries.definition: enjoy without paying 指免费享用本应付费的东西，如游戏、课程、内容。中文说「白嫖」，对应 freeloading，但更强调占便宜，常见于购物消费和追星语境。

examples.en: He always tries to enjoy without paying, like using free trials to watch whole seasons.
examples.zh: 他总是想白嫖，比如用免费试用看完整季剧集。

examples.en: Some fans just enjoy without paying, watching clips but never buying albums or voting.
examples.zh: 有些粉丝就是白嫖，只看片段，从不买专辑也不打投。

entries.shortAnswer: 「吃土」的英文是 broke after spending，指剁手购物后穷到没钱吃饭。注意它是自嘲式口语，多用于网购超支后的调侃，不是正式财务用语。
entries.definition: 吃土常与剁手、种草、拔草连用，构成「种草→拔草→吃土」消费链。英文可说 broke after a shopping spree，直译 eating dirt 只用于自嘲，需解释。搭配：I'm broke after spending too much。指短暂缺钱，非长期贫困。

examples.en: I'm totally broke after spending my whole paycheck on sneakers during the sale.
examples.zh: 大促时把整月工资都花在运动鞋上，我现在彻底吃土了。

examples.en: She was broke after spending too much on 618 shopping, so she ate instant noodles for a week.
examples.zh: 618 购物花太多钱后她吃土了，连吃了一周泡面。

entries.shortAnswer: 「broke after spending」的中文意思是「吃土」，即购物大花一笔后没钱了。它强调花钱导致的暂时拮据，与泛指贫穷的 poor 不同，多带自嘲语气。
entries.definition: broke after spending 是口语说法，指把预算花光后的短暂缺钱，常接 on clothes / at the mall 等。正式场合宜用 short on cash after expenses。注意 broke 在英语里多指暂时没钱，不指长期贫困。

examples.en: I'm totally broke after spending my whole paycheck on sneakers during the sale.
examples.zh: 大促时把整月工资都花在运动鞋上，我现在彻底吃土了。

examples.en: She was broke after spending too much on 618 shopping, so she ate instant noodles for a week.
examples.zh: 618 购物花太多钱后她吃土了，连吃了一周泡面。

entries.shortAnswer: 「薅羊毛」的英文是 score freebies and deals，指集中搜集优惠、占商家便宜，比 bargain hunting 更口语。
entries.definition: 薅羊毛指利用优惠券、满减、返现等规则以极低代价甚至免费获取商品或服务。搭配：score freebies and deals on Black Friday。注意「羊毛出在羊身上」：商家让利最终仍由消费者买单。

examples.en: Every Double Eleven, I stay up late to score freebies and deals with coupons and flash sales.
examples.zh: 每年双十一，我都熬夜用优惠券和限时抢购来薅羊毛。

examples.en: She knows how to score freebies and deals, but remember: the wool comes from the sheep.
examples.zh: 她很会薅羊毛，但要记住：羊毛出在羊身上。

entries.shortAnswer: score freebies and deals 的中文意思是「薅羊毛」，即集中搜集免费赠品和优惠、占商家便宜。
entries.definition: score freebies and deals 多用于口语和非正式购物场景，指通过优惠券、满减、赠品、返现等低成本获取商品。搭配：score freebies and deals with coupons。易错点：score 此处是“弄到、搞到”，不是“得分”。

examples.en: Every Double Eleven, I stay up late to score freebies and deals with coupons and flash sales.
examples.zh: 每年双十一，我都熬夜用优惠券和限时抢购来薅羊毛。

examples.en: She knows how to score freebies and deals, but remember: the wool comes from the sheep.
examples.zh: 她很会薅羊毛，但要记住：羊毛出在羊身上。

entries.shortAnswer: 「拔草」的英文可说 kill the desire to buy，指打消购买欲；但网络语境下「拔草」还可指终于买下种草之物，此时英文另有说法。
entries.definition: 拔草在中文网购圈有两义：① 冷静后打消购买念头，英文常用 kill the desire to buy 或 kill the urge to buy；② 把长期种草的物品买下，相当于「终于下手」。后一义不能直译，否则意思完全反了。

examples.en: I watched so many review videos that I almost bought the air fryer, but my budget finally killed the desire to buy.
examples.zh: 我看了好多测评视频，差点就买那台空气炸锅了，但最后预算让我拔草了。

examples.en: She added the designer bag to her cart three times, but reading the negative comments killed the desire to buy.
examples.zh: 她三次把那个名牌包加入购物车，但看了差评后就拔草了。

entries.shortAnswer: kill the desire to buy 的中文意思是「拔草」，指打消购买欲、忍住不买；但中文「拔草」还可指终于买下种草之物，此时不能用此英文。
entries.definition: kill the desire to buy 字面是「杀死购买欲」，对应中文「拔草」的第一义：冷静后决定不买，也可说 kill the urge to buy。它与「种草」方向相反；若想表达买下种草商品，英文应用 finally bought it 等。

examples.en: I watched so many review videos that I almost bought the air fryer, but my budget finally killed the desire to buy.
examples.zh: 我看了好多测评视频，差点就买那台空气炸锅了，但最后预算让我拔草了。

examples.en: She added the designer bag to her cart three times, but reading the negative comments killed the desire to buy.
examples.zh: 她三次把那个名牌包加入购物车，但看了差评后就拔草了。

entries.shortAnswer: 「月光族」英文是 live paycheck to paycheck，指工资月月花光、存不下钱。
entries.definition: live paycheck to paycheck 是固定搭配，paycheck 不能换成 salary，形容月月清零、靠下一份薪水过活。

examples.en: After paying rent and bills, I'm living paycheck to paycheck and can't save anything.
examples.zh: 交完房租和各种账单后，我成了月光族，根本存不下钱。

examples.en: Many young people in big cities live paycheck to paycheck because of high living costs.
examples.zh: 大城市里很多年轻人因为生活成本高，都过着月光族的日子。

entries.shortAnswer: live paycheck to paycheck means 「月光族」, spending all your pay each month and saving little.
entries.definition: live paycheck to paycheck is a fixed phrase; paycheck cannot be replaced by salary. It means having no savings buffer.

examples.en: After paying rent and bills, I'm living paycheck to paycheck and can't save anything.
examples.zh: 交完房租和各种账单后，我成了月光族，根本存不下钱。

examples.en: Many young people in big cities live paycheck to paycheck because of high living costs.
examples.zh: 大城市里很多年轻人因为生活成本高，都过着月光族的日子。

entries.shortAnswer: 「回购」的英文是 rebuy，指对用过的商品满意而再次购买，常见于美妆护肤等消费场景中。
entries.definition: rebuy 作动词，指对用过的商品满意而再次购买，常见搭配有 rebuy rate（回购率），也常用来描述消费者重复购买同一产品。

examples.en: I loved this serum so much that I decided to rebuy it during the big sale.
examples.zh: 我太喜欢这款精华了，决定在大促时回购它。

examples.en: She keeps a list of products she will rebuy, and anything that breaks her out goes straight back.
examples.zh: 她会列一份会回购的清单，而任何让她爆痘的产品都会直接退掉。

entries.shortAnswer: Rebuy means 回购: to buy a product again after liking it, a common term in shopping and beauty talk.
entries.definition: Rebuy is a verb meaning to purchase something again, often a cosmetic or skincare item you were happy with, as in rebuy rate.

examples.en: I loved this serum so much that I decided to rebuy it during the big sale.
examples.zh: 我太喜欢这款精华了，决定在大促时回购它。

examples.en: She keeps a list of products she will rebuy, and anything that breaks her out goes straight back.
examples.zh: 她会列一份会回购的清单，而任何让她爆痘的产品都会直接退掉。

entries.shortAnswer: 「断舍离」常译 declutter and let go，指清理杂物、放下执念，少买、清库存、处理闲置。
entries.definition: 「断舍离」源自日式整理术，强调清理物品来整理内心；英文 declutter and let go 偏动作与放下，不等于单纯打扫。

examples.en: After a year of impulse shopping, I decided to declutter and let go of everything I hadn't used, starting with the clothes still tagged.
examples.zh: 在冲动购物一年后，我决定断舍离，从那些还带着吊牌的衣服开始，把没用过的东西都处理掉。

examples.en: Her approach to declutter and let go is simple: before buying anything new, she clears out one item at home, especially near-expiry food or unused gadgets.
examples.zh: 她的断舍离方法很简单：买新东西前，先在家清理掉一件物品，尤其是临期食品或没用过的小家电。

entries.shortAnswer: Declutter and let go 中文常译「断舍离」，指清理杂物并放下执念，强调少买与不囤积。
entries.definition: Declutter and let go 是清理与放手的表达，可指物理空间或消费习惯，如少买、退掉闲置，比 tidy up 更重心理放下。

examples.en: After a year of impulse shopping, I decided to declutter and let go of everything I hadn't used, starting with the clothes still tagged.
examples.zh: 在冲动购物一年后，我决定断舍离，从那些还带着吊牌的衣服开始，把没用过的东西都处理掉。

examples.en: Her approach to declutter and let go is simple: before buying anything new, she clears out one item at home, especially near-expiry food or unused gadgets.
examples.zh: 她的断舍离方法很简单：买新东西前，先在家清理掉一件物品，尤其是临期食品或没用过的小家电。

entries.shortAnswer: 二手闲置英文是 secondhand idle items，指个人不用但仍可转卖或赠送的物品，强调闲置。
entries.definition: 常见搭配：sell/buy secondhand idle items、secondhand idle items 平台。idle 强调未被使用，不等于破旧。

examples.en: She listed her secondhand idle items on a resale app and sold most of them within a week.
examples.zh: 她把二手闲置挂到转卖应用上，一周内就卖掉了大部分。

examples.en: Buying secondhand idle items can save money and reduce waste, but always check the return policy and authenticity guarantee.
examples.zh: 购买二手闲置可以省钱又减少浪费，但一定要看清退货政策和正品保障。

entries.shortAnswer: Secondhand idle items means 二手闲置: used personal items no longer in use but available for resale.
entries.definition: Common in resale contexts: sell/buy secondhand idle items. 二手闲置 stresses personally unused items, not worn-out goods.

examples.en: She listed her secondhand idle items on a resale app and sold most of them within a week.
examples.zh: 她把二手闲置挂到转卖应用上，一周内就卖掉了大部分。

examples.en: Buying secondhand idle items can save money and reduce waste, but always check the return policy and authenticity guarantee.
examples.zh: 购买二手闲置可以省钱又减少浪费，但一定要看清退货政策和正品保障。

entries.shortAnswer: 「出闲置」的英文是 sell unused stuff，常用于二手平台，强调把不再使用的东西卖掉，比 sell second-hand 更口语。
entries.definition: 「出闲置」指把家里不用的物品转卖，常见搭配有 sell unused stuff online、sell unused stuff on Xianyu。注意与「断舍离」不同，后者侧重丢弃，前者侧重卖掉。

examples.en: I decided to sell unused stuff online to make some extra money after spring cleaning.
examples.zh: 大扫除后，我决定在网上出闲置，赚点外快。

examples.en: She often sells unused stuff on second-hand platforms instead of throwing it away.
examples.zh: 她经常在二手平台上出闲置，而不是直接扔掉。

entries.shortAnswer: Sell unused stuff 的中文意思是「出闲置」，强调把不再使用的物品卖掉，比 sell second-hand items 更口语，常见于二手平台。
entries.definition: Sell unused stuff 是口语表达，意思是出售自己不再使用的物品，常见搭配有 sell unused stuff online、sell unused stuff for cash。正式场合可用 sell surplus items。

examples.en: I decided to sell unused stuff online to make some extra money after spring cleaning.
examples.zh: 大扫除后，我决定在网上出闲置，赚点外快。

examples.en: She often sells unused stuff on second-hand platforms instead of throwing it away.
examples.zh: 她经常在二手平台上出闲置，而不是直接扔掉。

entries.shortAnswer: 退货包运费英语说 free return shipping，指商家承担退货运费，区别于仅免手续费的 free returns。
entries.definition: 退货包运费指退货时运费由商家承担，英文固定说法是 free return shipping，常与运费险配合使用。

examples.en: This store offers free return shipping on all orders, so you don't have to pay extra if you need to send something back.
examples.zh: 这家店所有订单都退货包运费，所以如果你需要退货，不用额外付钱。

examples.en: I always check whether a product comes with free return shipping before buying, especially for clothes.
examples.zh: 我买东西前总会检查是否退货包运费，尤其是买衣服的时候。

entries.shortAnswer: Free return shipping 即退货包运费，指商家承担退货运费，比 free returns 更具体，强调运费免费。
entries.definition: Free return shipping 指商家或平台承担退货产生的运费，常见于电商政策，需与仅免退货手续的 free returns 区分。

examples.en: This store offers free return shipping on all orders, so you don't have to pay extra if you need to send something back.
examples.zh: 这家店所有订单都退货包运费，所以如果你需要退货，不用额外付钱。

examples.en: I always check whether a product comes with free return shipping before buying, especially for clothes.
examples.zh: 我买东西前总会检查是否退货包运费，尤其是买衣服的时候。

entries.shortAnswer: 「电子收费」的英文是 ETC tolling，即高速公路不停车收费系统。注意 ETC 是电子不停车收费的缩写，tolling 强调收费行为。
entries.definition: 常见搭配：ETC tolling lane（电子收费车道）、ETC tolling system（电子收费系统）。易错点：人工车道是 manual toll lane 或 cash lane，不要混淆电子收费车道与人工车道。

examples.en: The new ETC tolling system has significantly reduced congestion at the highway exits.
examples.zh: 新的电子收费系统大大缓解了高速公路出口的拥堵。

examples.en: If your car doesn't have an ETC tag, you'll have to use the manual toll lane instead of the ETC tolling lane.
examples.zh: 如果你的车没有安装电子收费标签，你就必须走人工收费车道，而不是电子收费车道。

entries.shortAnswer: ETC tolling 的中文意思是「电子收费」，特指高速公路不停车收费系统。与普通 tolling 不同，ETC 强调电子化、不停车。
entries.definition: 核心词义：电子收费系统。常见搭配：ETC tolling lane（电子收费车道）、ETC tolling system（电子收费系统）。正式场合常用，口语中也可直接说 ETC。易错点：不要与 manual toll lane（人工收费车道）混淆。

examples.en: The new ETC tolling system has significantly reduced congestion at the highway exits.
examples.zh: 新的电子收费系统大大缓解了高速公路出口的拥堵。

examples.en: If your car doesn't have an ETC tag, you'll have to use the manual toll lane instead of the ETC tolling lane.
examples.zh: 如果你的车没有安装电子收费标签，你就必须走人工收费车道，而不是电子收费车道。

entries.shortAnswer: 「七天无理由退货」英文是 seven-day no-reason return，指网购法定冷静期，非商家自愿承诺。
entries.definition: seven-day no-reason return 是「七天无理由退货」的英文说法，法律上称冷静期，买家无需说明理由即可退货，属法定权利。

examples.en: As a cross-border shopper, I always check whether the store honors a seven-day no-reason return before adding items to my cart.
examples.zh: 作为跨境买家，我总要先确认店铺是否支持七天无理由退货，才把商品加入购物车。

examples.en: The seller refused my seven-day no-reason return, claiming the item was on the exclusion list, so I filed a complaint.
examples.zh: 卖家拒绝了我的七天无理由退货，说该商品在排除清单里，于是我发起了投诉。

entries.shortAnswer: seven-day no-reason return means 七天无理由退货, China's statutory cooling-off period for online shopping.
entries.definition: seven-day no-reason return is the English for 七天无理由退货, China's legal right to return online purchases without a reason, not a courtesy.

examples.en: As a cross-border shopper, I always check whether the store honors a seven-day no-reason return before adding items to my cart.
examples.zh: 作为跨境买家，我总要先确认店铺是否支持七天无理由退货，才把商品加入购物车。

examples.en: The seller refused my seven-day no-reason return, claiming the item was on the exclusion list, so I filed a complaint.
examples.zh: 卖家拒绝了我的七天无理由退货，说该商品在排除清单里，于是我发起了投诉。

entries.shortAnswer: 过户的英文是 transfer ownership，指车辆、房产等所有权正式转移登记，不是单纯交钥匙。
entries.definition: 过户强调法律上的所有权转移，常搭配 transfer ownership of a car/house。正式文件多用此说法。

examples.en: You need to transfer ownership of the vehicle at the DMV before you can legally drive it.
examples.zh: 你必须先在车管所办理车辆过户，才能合法上路。

examples.en: The seller agreed to transfer ownership to the buyer after the full payment was made.
examples.zh: 卖方同意在收到全款后把所有权过户给买方。

entries.shortAnswer: transfer ownership 的中文意思是过户，特指车辆、房产等所有权的正式转移登记，比 give 更正式。
entries.definition: transfer ownership 常用于车辆、房产等资产，搭配 of 或 to：transfer ownership of the car to someone。

examples.en: You need to transfer ownership of the vehicle at the DMV before you can legally drive it.
examples.zh: 你必须先在车管所办理车辆过户，才能合法上路。

examples.en: The seller agreed to transfer ownership to the buyer after the full payment was made.
examples.zh: 卖方同意在收到全款后把所有权过户给买方。

entries.shortAnswer: 「正品保障」的英文是 authenticity guarantee，指平台承诺所售商品为真品而非假货。
entries.definition: 常见搭配：offer/provide an authenticity guarantee。易错点：不要直译为 genuine guarantee，常与 100% authentic 并用。

examples.en: This online store offers an authenticity guarantee on all luxury bags, so you can shop without worrying about fakes.
examples.zh: 这家网店对所有奢侈品包提供正品保障，所以你可以放心购物，不用担心买到假货。

examples.en: Before buying second-hand sneakers, check whether the platform provides an authenticity guarantee.
examples.zh: 购买二手运动鞋前，先确认平台是否提供正品保障。

entries.shortAnswer: Authenticity guarantee 的中文意思是「正品保障」，指商家承诺商品为正品而非假冒。
entries.definition: 核心义：对商品真实性的正式保证，常见搭配有 offer/provide an authenticity guarantee，多用于电商和奢侈品交易。

examples.en: This online store offers an authenticity guarantee on all luxury bags, so you can shop without worrying about fakes.
examples.zh: 这家网店对所有奢侈品包提供正品保障，所以你可以放心购物，不用担心买到假货。

examples.en: Before buying second-hand sneakers, check whether the platform provides an authenticity guarantee.
examples.zh: 购买二手运动鞋前，先确认平台是否提供正品保障。

entries.shortAnswer: 「大巴」的英文是 intercity coach，指城市间或团体出行的大型客车。注意与市内公交 bus 区分，英式常说 coach，美式常说 intercity bus。
entries.definition: 大巴通常指长途或团体用的大型客车，如旅游大巴、长途大巴；常见搭配有 by intercity coach、charter an intercity coach。市内线路公交一般说 city bus 或 public bus。

examples.en: We took an intercity coach from Shanghai to Hangzhou and arrived in about three hours.
examples.zh: 我们坐大巴从上海到杭州，大约三个小时就到了。

examples.en: The travel agency chartered an intercity coach to take the group to the ancient town.
examples.zh: 旅行社包了一辆大巴，送团队去古镇。

entries.shortAnswer: intercity coach 的中文意思是「大巴」，指城市间或团体出行的大型客车。它区别于市内公交 bus，英式英语多用 coach，美式英语多用 intercity bus。
entries.definition: intercity coach 指长途或团体用的大型客车，常见搭配有 travel by intercity coach、a charter coach。正式场合和英式英语常用 coach，美式口语也可说 intercity bus。

examples.en: We took an intercity coach from Shanghai to Hangzhou and arrived in about three hours.
examples.zh: 我们坐大巴从上海到杭州，大约三个小时就到了。

examples.en: The travel agency chartered an intercity coach to take the group to the ancient town.
examples.zh: 旅行社包了一辆大巴，送团队去古镇。

entries.shortAnswer: 「实习期」在驾驶语境下英文是 new-driver probation，指拿到驾照后的一年考察期。注意：职场上的实习叫 internship，别把这俩搞混。
entries.definition: new-driver probation 专指驾照实习期，通常为 12 个月，需贴实习标，上高速须有三年以上驾龄者陪同。职场实习则用 internship，同词两境，千万别用错。

examples.en: During my new-driver probation, I had to display a probation sign on my car and couldn't drive on the highway alone.
examples.zh: 在我的驾照实习期内，我必须在车上贴实习标志，而且不能独自上高速。

examples.en: She got her license last month, so she's still in her new-driver probation and needs a licensed driver beside her on the expressway.
examples.zh: 她上个月刚拿到驾照，所以还在实习期内，上高速公路时需要有持证驾驶员陪同。

entries.shortAnswer: 「new-driver probation」的中文意思是「实习期」，特指新驾驶员领证后的考察阶段。它和职场里的 internship 完全不同，别混淆。
