entries.definition: new-driver probation 指新驾驶员必须经历的考察期，通常一年，需贴实习标志，部分路段或高速有特殊限制。口语中也说 probationary period for new drivers，但别和 intern 的实习期混用。

examples.en: During my new-driver probation, I had to display a probation sign on my car and couldn't drive on the highway alone.
examples.zh: 在我的驾照实习期内，我必须在车上贴实习标志，而且不能独自上高速。

examples.en: She got her license last month, so she's still in her new-driver probation and needs a licensed driver beside her on the expressway.
examples.zh: 她上个月刚拿到驾照，所以还在实习期内，上高速公路时需要有持证驾驶员陪同。

entries.shortAnswer: 「拍牌」的英文是 bid for a license plate，指出价竞拍上海车牌额度，价高者得，不同于北京摇号。
entries.definition: 拍牌指上海每月举行的私车额度拍卖，价高者得，中标价常近十万，故称「最贵铁皮」。常说拍牌价格、拍中、拍牌失败。英文 bid for a license plate 强调竞价，勿与 lottery 混用。

examples.en: In Shanghai, you have to bid for a license plate, and the winning price can be nearly 100,000 yuan.
examples.zh: 在上海，你得拍牌，中标价可能接近十万元。

examples.en: She failed to bid for a license plate last month, so her new car still has no local plates.
examples.zh: 她上个月拍牌失败，所以新车还没上本地牌照。

entries.shortAnswer: bid for a license plate 的中文意思是「拍牌」，指竞拍上海私车牌照额度，与北京摇号的抽签机制不同。
entries.definition: bid for a license plate 指通过出价竞标取得车牌，多用于上海车牌拍卖。搭配：bid for a license plate successfully（拍中）、fail to bid。易错点是与 lottery（摇号）混用。

examples.en: In Shanghai, you have to bid for a license plate, and the winning price can be nearly 100,000 yuan.
examples.zh: 在上海，你得拍牌，中标价可能接近十万元。

examples.en: She failed to bid for a license plate last month, so her new car still has no local plates.
examples.zh: 她上个月拍牌失败，所以新车还没上本地牌照。

entries.shortAnswer: 「候补」的英文是 waitlist for tickets，特指中国12306无票时排队等退票的机制。日常口语也可说 get on the waitlist。
entries.definition: 候补购票是中国铁路12306的独特功能：车票售罄后先付款排队，有人退票或改签时系统按顺序自动分配。英文常说 waitlist for tickets 或 join the waitlist，注意不是普通排队 queue。

examples.en: During the Spring Festival travel rush, I always waitlist for tickets on 12306 because they sell out in seconds.
examples.zh: 春运期间，我总是在12306上候补购票，因为车票几秒钟就卖光了。

examples.en: She waitlisted for tickets and got a seat the day before departure when someone refunded theirs.
examples.zh: 她提交了候补订单，出发前一天有人退票，她就成功补到了座位。

entries.shortAnswer: waitlist for tickets 的中文意思是「候补」，指中国火车票无票时排队等退票的购票机制。它与普通 waitlist 不同，有自动抢票和先付款后兑现的特点。
entries.definition: waitlist for tickets 是中国特色铁路购票术语，指在12306上预付票款、按排队顺序等待退票或余票自动补位。比普通 waitlist 多了自动分配和先付款机制，常用于高铁和火车票语境。

examples.en: During the Spring Festival travel rush, I always waitlist for tickets on 12306 because they sell out in seconds.
examples.zh: 春运期间，我总是在12306上候补购票，因为车票几秒钟就卖光了。

examples.en: She waitlisted for tickets and got a seat the day before departure when someone refunded theirs.
examples.zh: 她提交了候补订单，出发前一天有人退票，她就成功补到了座位。

entries.shortAnswer: 「站票」的英文是 standing ticket，指无座位、需站立的车票。注意：站票通常与坐票同价，但可乘同一趟车，英文也说 standing room only。
entries.definition: 铁路出行中，站票常译作 standing ticket；若强调车厢只有站位，用 standing room only。买站票上车后有空座可暂坐，但让座给持坐票乘客是基本礼仪。

examples.en: During the Spring Festival travel rush, I could only get a standing ticket for the high-speed train.
examples.zh: 春运期间，我只买到了高铁的站票。

examples.en: The conductor announced standing room only, so we squeezed into the carriage with our standing tickets.
examples.zh: 列车员宣布只有站票了，我们便拿着站票挤进了车厢。

entries.shortAnswer: 「standing ticket」的中文意思是「站票」，即无座、需站立的车票。它不同于 seat reservation，不保证有座位，常见于火车和演出。
entries.definition: standing ticket 指无座票，与坐票同价但只能站立；列车长常喊 standing room only 表示仅剩站位。口语中也可说 standing-room ticket，注意不是站台票。

examples.en: During the Spring Festival travel rush, I could only get a standing ticket for the high-speed train.
examples.zh: 春运期间，我只买到了高铁的站票。

examples.en: The conductor announced standing room only, so we squeezed into the carriage with our standing tickets.
examples.zh: 列车员宣布只有站票了，我们便拿着站票挤进了车厢。

entries.shortAnswer: 中转 的英文是 layover stop，指行程中途换乘，在航班语境中常用 layover 或 transfer。注意 layover 更强调停留等待，transfer 更强调换乘动作。
entries.definition: layover stop 指长途旅行中在中途城市停留换乘，常见搭配有 have a layover stop in、a long layover stop。航班中转常说 layover，机场内换乘则说 transfer。

examples.en: We have a three-hour layover stop in Hong Kong before flying to Sydney.
examples.zh: 我们在香港中转停留三个小时，然后飞往悉尼。

examples.en: Because of the weather, our layover stop in Chicago was extended by two hours.
examples.zh: 因为天气原因，我们在芝加哥的中转停留延长了两个小时。

entries.shortAnswer: layover stop 的中文意思是 中转，指旅程中途停留换乘，尤其常用于航班。区别在于 layover 强调停留等待，transfer 更强调换乘动作。
entries.definition: layover stop 指旅行中途停留换乘点，常用于航班，也可用于长途巴士或火车。常见搭配：have a layover stop in、a two-hour layover stop。正式场合可用 transfer，口语中常用 layover。

examples.en: We have a three-hour layover stop in Hong Kong before flying to Sydney.
examples.zh: 我们在香港中转停留三个小时，然后飞往悉尼。

examples.en: Because of the weather, our layover stop in Chicago was extended by two hours.
examples.zh: 因为天气原因，我们在芝加哥的中转停留延长了两个小时。

entries.shortAnswer: 「接站」的英文是 pick up at the station，指到车站接人。注意：这里的“站”通常指火车站或汽车站，不是地铁站；若接机则说 pick up at the airport。
entries.definition: 接站指专程到车站迎接某人，英文用 pick (someone) up at the station，宾语放中间：pick you up at the station。常用于接亲友、客户或同事；若在站台等候可说 meet you at the station。

examples.en: I'll pick you up at the station tomorrow morning, so wait by the north exit.
examples.zh: 我明天早上去车站接你，你在北出口等就行。

examples.en: He asked his colleague to pick up the client at the station and drive her to the hotel.
examples.zh: 他请同事去车站接客户，然后开车送她去酒店。

entries.shortAnswer: pick up at the station 的中文意思是「接站」，即到车站接人。它与 meet at the station 略有区别：pick up 强调开车接送并一同离开，meet 只强调见面。
entries.definition: pick up at the station 指开车到火车站或汽车站接某人，宾语可置于 pick 与 up 之间，如 pick her up at the station。口语常用，接机则替换为 at the airport；注意不要与地铁站混淆。

examples.en: I'll pick you up at the station tomorrow morning, so wait by the north exit.
examples.zh: 我明天早上去车站接你，你在北出口等就行。

examples.en: He asked his colleague to pick up the client at the station and drive her to the hotel.
examples.zh: 他请同事去车站接客户，然后开车送她去酒店。

entries.shortAnswer: 「卧铺」的英文是 sleeper berth，列车供躺卧的铺位，注意与 bunk 区分。
entries.definition: 火车卧铺英文称 sleeper berth，也简称 berth，车厢叫 sleeper 或 sleeping car。分上中下铺：upper、middle、lower berth。

examples.en: I booked a lower sleeper berth for the overnight train to Xi'an.
examples.zh: 我订了去西安的夜班火车的下铺。

examples.en: The sleeper berths on the old green train are cheaper than soft sleeper compartments.
examples.zh: 老式绿皮火车的卧铺比软卧包间便宜。

entries.shortAnswer: Sleeper berth is 卧铺 in Chinese—the berth you sleep in on a train.
entries.definition: A sleeper berth is a bed on a train, especially in a sleeping car. It is more specific than bunk. Book an upper or lower sleeper berth.

examples.en: I booked a lower sleeper berth for the overnight train to Xi'an.
examples.zh: 我订了去西安的夜班火车的下铺。

examples.en: The sleeper berths on the old green train are cheaper than soft sleeper compartments.
examples.zh: 老式绿皮火车的卧铺比软卧包间便宜。

entries.shortAnswer: 绿皮车的英文是 old green trains，指中国铁路老式绿色涂装的普速列车。
entries.definition: 绿皮车指中国铁路老式绿色涂装普速列车，速度慢、票价低、停站多。英文常说 old green trains，常带怀旧色彩。

examples.en: Many travelers still choose old green trains for the cheap tickets and the nostalgic atmosphere.
examples.zh: 许多旅客仍然选择绿皮车，因为票价便宜，还有怀旧氛围。

examples.en: Compared with high-speed rail, old green trains are slower but stop at more small stations.
examples.zh: 与高铁相比，绿皮车速度较慢，但会停靠更多小站。

entries.shortAnswer: old green trains 的中文是绿皮车，指中国铁路老式绿色涂装的普速列车。
entries.definition: old green trains 指中国铁路老式绿色涂装普速列车，速度慢、票价低、停站多，常带怀旧感。

examples.en: Many travelers still choose old green trains for the cheap tickets and the nostalgic atmosphere.
examples.zh: 许多旅客仍然选择绿皮车，因为票价便宜，还有怀旧氛围。

examples.en: Compared with high-speed rail, old green trains are slower but stop at more small stations.
examples.zh: 与高铁相比，绿皮车速度较慢，但会停靠更多小站。

entries.shortAnswer: 「托运」的英文是 check in luggage；指在机场或火车站把行李交给工作人员统一运送，不是快递寄送。
entries.definition: 在机场、火车站办理行李托运时，用 check in luggage 或 check luggage；注意区分快递托运（ship/consign），后者用于寄包裹，不用于旅客随身行李。

examples.en: You need to check in luggage at the counter before going through security.
examples.zh: 你需要在过安检前到柜台办理行李托运。

examples.en: We arrived early to check in luggage and avoid the long queue.
examples.zh: 我们提早到达办理行李托运，以免排长队。

entries.shortAnswer: 「check in luggage」的中文意思是「托运」；指在机场或火车站把行李交给工作人员统一运送，区别于随身携带。
entries.definition: check in luggage 表示办理行李托运，常见于机场和火车站；英式英语也常说 check in baggage，口语中可省略 luggage 只说 check in。

examples.en: You need to check in luggage at the counter before going through security.
examples.zh: 你需要在过安检前到柜台办理行李托运。

examples.en: We arrived early to check in luggage and avoid the long queue.
examples.zh: 我们提早到达办理行李托运，以免排长队。

entries.shortAnswer: 「错峰出行」的英文是 travel off-peak，指避开客流高峰时段出行。注意「峰」指客流高峰，不是山峰，别逐字译成 wrong peak。
entries.definition: 常用搭配：travel off-peak、stagger travel times（错开出行时间）。春运、黄金周官方英文提示常建议错峰出行，强调避开拥堵和抢票高峰。反义为 travel at peak times。

examples.en: To avoid the crowds during Spring Festival, we decided to travel off-peak and leave two days earlier.
examples.zh: 为了避开春运人流，我们决定错峰出行，提前两天出发。

examples.en: The airline offers cheaper tickets if you travel off-peak, such as on weekday mornings.
examples.zh: 如果你错峰出行，比如选工作日早上，航空公司会提供更便宜的机票。

entries.shortAnswer: travel off-peak 的中文意思是「错峰出行」，即避开客流高峰时段出行。它强调时间选择，不等于 go on a wrong trip 或走错路线。
entries.definition: travel off-peak 为中性偏正式表达，常见于交通公告、春运和黄金周出行建议。peak 指客流高峰，off-peak 即非高峰时段；口语也可说 travel at off-peak times。反义：travel during peak hours。

examples.en: To avoid the crowds during Spring Festival, we decided to travel off-peak and leave two days earlier.
examples.zh: 为了避开春运人流，我们决定错峰出行，提前两天出发。

examples.en: The airline offers cheaper tickets if you travel off-peak, such as on weekday mornings.
examples.zh: 如果你错峰出行，比如选工作日早上，航空公司会提供更便宜的机票。

entries.shortAnswer: 「爱豆」的英文就是 idol，是 idol 的音译借词，比「偶像」更萌更亲密，专指受粉丝追捧的年轻艺人。注意 idol 在英语里本义是神像或崇拜对象，追星义是后来扩展的。
entries.definition: 爱豆是 idol 的音译借词，与「粉丝」（fan）同属一套亲密化机制：把外来词直接音译当昵称用，语气比「偶像」更轻松可爱。常见搭配：追爱豆、爱豆回归、爱豆营业。注意：英语 idol 本义是神像、受崇拜的人，追星义在当代口语中才流行。

examples.en: My idol just dropped a new album, and I've been streaming it nonstop.
examples.zh: 我爱豆刚发了新专辑，我一直在循环播放。

examples.en: She waited outside the venue for hours just to catch a glimpse of her idol.
examples.zh: 她在场馆外等了好几个小时，就为了看一眼她的爱豆。

entries.shortAnswer: 「idol」的中文意思是「爱豆」，即受粉丝追捧的年轻艺人，是 idol 的音译借词，比「偶像」更亲切。与「明星」不同，idol 强调粉丝情感投射和流量属性。
entries.definition: idol 本义是神像、受崇拜的对象，后引申为被狂热追捧的艺人。在追星语境下，中文常译为「爱豆」，比「偶像」更口语化、萌化。常见搭配：pop idol、teen idol、idol group。正式场合仍可用 idol 指偶像，但追星义更常见于娱乐新闻和粉丝圈。

examples.en: My idol just dropped a new album, and I've been streaming it nonstop.
examples.zh: 我爱豆刚发了新专辑，我一直在循环播放。

examples.en: She waited outside the venue for hours just to catch a glimpse of her idol.
examples.zh: 她在场馆外等了好几个小时，就为了看一眼她的爱豆。

entries.shortAnswer: 年检的英文是 annual vehicle inspection，指车辆每年安全与排放检测，不是人体体检。
entries.definition: 年检即 annual vehicle inspection，指机动车每年例行的安全与排放检验。常见搭配：pass/fail the annual vehicle inspection（年检合格/不合格）。

examples.en: My car is due for its annual vehicle inspection next month, so I need to book an appointment at the testing station.
examples.zh: 我的车下个月该年检了，所以我需要预约检测站。

examples.en: If your car fails the annual vehicle inspection, you must fix the problems and have it retested before you can legally drive it.
examples.zh: 如果你的车年检不合格，必须修好问题并重新检测，然后才能合法上路。

entries.shortAnswer: 年检 is annual vehicle inspection, a yearly safety and emissions test for cars.
entries.definition: Annual vehicle inspection (年检) is a yearly vehicle safety and emissions test. Common collocations: pass/fail the annual vehicle inspection.

examples.en: My car is due for its annual vehicle inspection next month, so I need to book an appointment at the testing station.
examples.zh: 我的车下个月该年检了，所以我需要预约检测站。

examples.en: If your car fails the annual vehicle inspection, you must fix the problems and have it retested before you can legally drive it.
examples.zh: 如果你的车年检不合格，必须修好问题并重新检测，然后才能合法上路。

entries.shortAnswer: 「绕行」的英文是 take a detour，多指因修路、事故或导航提示而绕道走。detour 作名词指「绕行路段」，take a detour 才是动词短语「绕行」。
entries.definition: take a detour 意为「绕道、绕行」，常与 have to、be forced to 连用，如 we had to take a detour（我们不得不绕行）。导航中可说 Construction ahead, please take a detour。

examples.en: Because of the road construction, we had to take a detour and arrived twenty minutes late.
examples.zh: 因为道路施工，我们不得不绕行，结果迟到了二十分钟。

examples.en: The navigation app told us to take a detour to avoid the traffic jam on the highway.
examples.zh: 导航应用让我们绕行，以避开高速公路上的堵车。

entries.shortAnswer: 「take a detour」的中文意思是「绕行」，指不走直路而绕道走。它比 go around 更正式，常用于交通、导航和修路场景，可主动或被迫绕行。
entries.definition: take a detour 是动词短语，意为「绕道、绕行」，常见搭配有 have to take a detour、be forced to take a detour。detour 也可作名词，指「绕行路线」。

examples.en: Because of the road construction, we had to take a detour and arrived twenty minutes late.
examples.zh: 因为道路施工，我们不得不绕行，结果迟到了二十分钟。

examples.en: The navigation app told us to take a detour to avoid the traffic jam on the highway.
examples.zh: 导航应用让我们绕行，以避开高速公路上的堵车。

entries.shortAnswer: 「违章查询」的英文是 check traffic violations，用于查看交通违法记录，不含缴罚款。
entries.definition: check traffic violations 指查询交通违法记录，可搭配 online、app、车管所等。注意不是缴罚款。

examples.en: Before the annual inspection, you should check traffic violations online to make sure there are no unpaid fines.
examples.zh: 年检前，你应该在线查询违章，确认没有未缴罚款。

examples.en: Drivers can check traffic violations through the official app or at the vehicle management office.
examples.zh: 司机可以通过官方应用或去车管所查询违章。

entries.shortAnswer: check traffic violations 的中文是「违章查询」，指查看交通违法记录，不含缴罚款。
entries.definition: check traffic violations 用于交通出行，可在线或去车管所查询违章记录。常见搭配：online、app。

examples.en: Before the annual inspection, you should check traffic violations online to make sure there are no unpaid fines.
examples.zh: 年检前，你应该在线查询违章，确认没有未缴罚款。

examples.en: Drivers can check traffic violations through the official app or at the vehicle management office.
examples.zh: 司机可以通过官方应用或去车管所查询违章。

entries.shortAnswer: 「打榜」的英文是 vote for the charts，指粉丝投票刷数据，把偶像推上音乐榜或热搜榜。贬义语境常用 chart manipulation。
entries.definition: 打榜常与「打投」联动，即粉丝集中投票、刷播放量把偶像推上榜单。vote for the charts 较中性，chart manipulation 带贬义。

examples.en: Fans stayed up all night to vote for the charts and push their idol's new single to number one.
examples.zh: 粉丝们通宵打榜，把偶像的新单曲推上第一名。

examples.en: Some critics accuse agencies of chart manipulation, saying the mass voting is less about music than about a desire to vote for the charts.
examples.zh: 一些批评者指责经纪公司操纵榜单，称这种大规模投票与其说是为了音乐，不如说是出于打榜的欲望。

entries.shortAnswer: vote for the charts 的中文是「打榜」，指粉丝为偶像冲榜单排名而投票刷数据，负面语境下近于 chart manipulation。
entries.definition: vote for the charts 多用于饭圈，指粉丝投票刷数据冲榜。中性强调投票冲榜，若指操纵排名则用 chart manipulation。

examples.en: Fans stayed up all night to vote for the charts and push their idol's new single to number one.
examples.zh: 粉丝们通宵打榜，把偶像的新单曲推上第一名。

examples.en: Some critics accuse agencies of chart manipulation, saying the mass voting is less about music than about a desire to vote for the charts.
examples.zh: 一些批评者指责经纪公司操纵榜单，称这种大规模投票与其说是为了音乐，不如说是出于打榜的欲望。

entries.shortAnswer: 「唁CP」用英语说是 ship a couple，指粉丝把两个人物配对并希望他们在一起。
entries.definition: ship a couple 是粉丝圈常用表达，ship 源自 relationship，作动词表示支持某对 CP 的恋爱关系。常见搭配：ship them、ship a couple hard。

examples.en: I ship a couple from that new idol drama so hard that I keep rewatching their scenes.
examples.zh: 我特别嗑那部新爱豆剧里的一对 CP，以至于反复重看他们的片段。

examples.en: Fans often ship a couple based on chemistry, even if the show never makes them canon.
examples.zh: 粉丝常常根据化学反应来嗑 CP，即使剧里从未让他们成为官方配对。

entries.shortAnswer: ship a couple 的中文意思是「唁CP」，即粉丝把两个人配对并希望他们发展恋爱关系。
entries.definition: ship a couple 是粉丝文化口语表达，ship 作动词，源自 relationship。常见搭配：ship them、ship a couple hard、I don't ship it。

examples.en: I ship a couple from that new idol drama so hard that I keep rewatching their scenes.
examples.zh: 我特别嗑那部新爱豆剧里的一对 CP，以至于反复重看他们的片段。

examples.en: Fans often ship a couple based on chemistry, even if the show never makes them canon.
examples.zh: 粉丝常常根据化学反应来嗑 CP，即使剧里从未让他们成为官方配对。

entries.shortAnswer: 「追星」的英文常译作 fandom life，指围绕偶像展开的粉丝生活总称。它比单说 following idols 更强调日常化、持续性的追星状态，不是一次性的喜欢。
entries.definition: fandom life 侧重「粉丝生活方式」，口语常说 live the fandom life、my fandom life。若强调具体追随行为，用 following idols；若强调狂热粉丝文化，用 stan culture，stan 源自 Eminem 歌曲，已进词典。

examples.en: Since she started living the fandom life, her weekends are all about concerts and fan events.
examples.zh: 自从她开始追星，周末就全被演唱会和粉丝活动占满了。

examples.en: For many students, fandom life is a way to relieve stress, but they still need to balance it with study.
examples.zh: 对很多学生来说，追星是一种减压方式，但仍需与学习平衡。

entries.shortAnswer: Fandom life 的中文意思是「追星」，即作为粉丝追随偶像的整套生活状态。它不等于一次追现场，而更强调长期投入、应援、打榜、嗑 CP 等日常。
entries.definition: Fandom life 指粉丝群体的生活方式与情感投入，常搭配 live the fandom life、part of my fandom life。口语、社媒常用；正式写作可说 fan culture。注意它不是「同人圈」本身，而是以偶像追随为核心的粉丝生活。

examples.en: Since she started living the fandom life, her weekends are all about concerts and fan events.
examples.zh: 自从她开始追星，周末就全被演唱会和粉丝活动占满了。

examples.en: For many students, fandom life is a way to relieve stress, but they still need to balance it with study.
examples.zh: 对很多学生来说，追星是一种减压方式，但仍需与学习平衡。

entries.shortAnswer: 「应援」的英文是 fan support，指粉丝集体出钱出力为偶像造势、宣传或送礼物。
entries.definition: 应援源自日语「応援」，经韩流传入中国，现包括灯牌、物资、控评等。英文常用不可数名词 fan support，动词可说 support the idol。

examples.en: The fan club organized fan support for the singer's birthday, buying subway ads and light sticks.
examples.zh: 粉丝团为这位歌手的生日组织了应援，购买了地铁广告和灯牌。

examples.en: Fans gave strong fan support to the actor after his new drama aired, trending his name online.
examples.zh: 新剧播出后，粉丝们给这位演员做了强力应援，把他的名字刷上了热搜。

entries.shortAnswer: Fan support means 应援: fans backing an idol with money, gifts or publicity.
entries.definition: Fan support covers cheering, light sticks, gifts and online drives for a celebrity. It is uncountable: give fan support, not a fan support.

examples.en: The fan club organized fan support for the singer's birthday, buying subway ads and light sticks.
examples.zh: 粉丝团为这位歌手的生日组织了应援，购买了地铁广告和灯牌。

examples.en: Fans gave strong fan support to the actor after his new drama aired, trending his name online.
examples.zh: 新剧播出后，粉丝们给这位演员做了强力应援，把他的名字刷上了热搜。

entries.shortAnswer: 「代拍」的英文是 paid paparazzi shots，指粉丝付费请人拍摄的明星路透照片。
entries.definition: 代拍指粉丝付费委托他人拍摄的明星照片，英文为 paid paparazzi shots。与主动偷拍隐私的狗仔不同，代拍多拍公开行程，属灰色产业链。

examples.en: The fan club raised money to buy paid paparazzi shots of the idol at the airport.
examples.zh: 粉丝团凑钱购买偶像在机场的代拍照片。

examples.en: She was criticized for selling paid paparazzi shots of celebrities to gossip accounts.
examples.zh: 她因向八卦账号出售明星代拍照片而受到批评。

entries.shortAnswer: paid paparazzi shots 的中文是「代拍」，即粉丝付费请人拍摄的明星路透照片。
entries.definition: paid paparazzi shots 指粉丝付费给拍摄者拍到的明星照片，属粉丝文化中的灰色产业链。常见搭配：sell paid paparazzi shots、leak paid paparazzi shots。

examples.en: The fan club raised money to buy paid paparazzi shots of the idol at the airport.
examples.zh: 粉丝团凑钱购买偶像在机场的代拍照片。

examples.en: She was criticized for selling paid paparazzi shots of celebrities to gossip accounts.
examples.zh: 她因向八卦账号出售明星代拍照片而受到批评。

entries.shortAnswer: 「私生饭」的英文是 sasaeng fan，指跟踪、偷拍、骚扰偶像私生活的极端粉丝。
entries.definition: sasaeng fan 借自韩语，专指侵犯偶像隐私、跟踪偷拍的极端粉丝，不能泛指普通追星族。

examples.en: The agency filed a lawsuit against a sasaeng fan who followed the idol to a private schedule.
examples.zh: 经纪公司对一名跟踪偶像私人行程的私生饭提起了诉讼。

examples.en: She was labeled a sasaeng fan after illegally getting the singer's flight info and waiting at the airport.
examples.zh: 她因非法获取歌手的航班信息并在机场蹲守，被贴上了私生饭的标签。

entries.shortAnswer: Sasaeng fan is 私生饭 in Chinese: an obsessive fan who invades an idol's privacy.
entries.definition: Sasaeng fan means 私生饭: a Korean-derived term for an extreme fan who stalks or harasses idols. Not for ordinary fans.

examples.en: The agency filed a lawsuit against a sasaeng fan who followed the idol to a private schedule.
examples.zh: 经纪公司对一名跟踪偶像私人行程的私生饭提起了诉讼。

examples.en: She was labeled a sasaeng fan after illegally getting the singer's flight info and waiting at the airport.
examples.zh: 她因非法获取歌手的航班信息并在机场蹲守，被贴上了私生饭的标签。

entries.shortAnswer: 「演唱会」的英文是 live concert，指歌手现场真唱演出；live 在此读 /laɪv/，不是「居住」的 /lɪv/。
entries.definition: live concert 强调现场演出、非录播，常搭 go to、attend、hold、ticket，如 live concert ticket（演唱会门票）；口语也常只说 concert。

examples.en: I queued for three hours to get a live concert ticket for my favorite idol.
examples.zh: 我排了三个小时的队，就为了买到我最喜欢的偶像的演唱会门票。

examples.en: The live concert lasted until midnight, and the whole stadium sang along.
examples.zh: 这场演唱会一直持续到午夜，整个体育场的人都跟着一起唱。

entries.shortAnswer: live concert 的中文意思是「演唱会」，指歌手或乐队当着现场观众演唱的音乐演出。
entries.definition: live concert 指观众到场、歌手当场演唱的音乐会，常说 go to / attend / hold a live concert；live 作「现场」时读 /laɪv/。

examples.en: I queued for three hours to get a live concert ticket for my favorite idol.
examples.zh: 我排了三个小时的队，就为了买到我最喜欢的偶像的演唱会门票。

examples.en: The live concert lasted until midnight, and the whole stadium sang along.
examples.zh: 这场演唱会一直持续到午夜，整个体育场的人都跟着一起唱。

entries.shortAnswer: 「发糖」英文常说 drop sweet moments，指偶像或剧集给粉丝制造甜蜜互动，属饭圈口语。
entries.definition: 「发糖」指偶像、CP 或剧组放出甜蜜互动让粉丝「吃到糖」。英文 drop sweet moments 强调投放动作，feed the fans 强调投喂粉丝。

examples.en: The two leads dropped sweet moments behind the scenes, and fans immediately started shipping them even harder.
examples.zh: 两位主演在幕后发糖，粉丝立刻嗑得更起劲了。

examples.en: My favorite idol loves to drop sweet moments on Weibo before a comeback, which always sends the fandom into a frenzy.
examples.zh: 我最喜欢的偶像总爱在回归前在微博上发糖，每次都让饭圈沸腾。

entries.shortAnswer: Drop sweet moments means 发糖: idols or shows release sweet interactions for fans. It is fandom slang.
entries.definition: Drop sweet moments is fandom slang meaning 发糖: an idol or on-screen couple releases cute moments to feed fans, often alongside ship.

examples.en: The two leads dropped sweet moments behind the scenes, and fans immediately started shipping them even harder.
examples.zh: 两位主演在幕后发糖，粉丝立刻嗑得更起劲了。

examples.en: My favorite idol loves to drop sweet moments on Weibo before a comeback, which always sends the fandom into a frenzy.
examples.zh: 我最喜欢的偶像总爱在回归前在微博上发糖，每次都让饭圈沸腾。

entries.shortAnswer: 中文「刀子」在饭圈指虐心剧情，英文常说 heartbreak plot，与发糖相反。
entries.definition: 粉丝圈用语，指影视、小说或偶像内容里官方刻意安排的虐心情节，常说「发刀子」「吃刀子」，不是现实伤心事。

examples.en: The writer dropped a major heartbreak plot in episode ten, right after two episodes of pure fluff.
examples.zh: 编剧在第十集扔下一把大刀子，前两集还全是纯甜发糖。

examples.en: Fans keep joking that this show serves a heartbreak plot every other week to keep them emotionally hooked.
examples.zh: 粉丝老开玩笑说这剧每隔一周就发一次刀子，好让大家一直上头。

entries.shortAnswer: Chinese fan slang 「刀子」 means a sad storyline, known in English as a heartbreak plot.
entries.definition: Fandom term for a plot beat made to break viewers' hearts in dramas, novels, or idol content; informal and fan-specific, not real grief.

examples.en: The writer dropped a major heartbreak plot in episode ten, right after two episodes of pure fluff.
examples.zh: 编剧在第十集扔下一把大刀子，前两集还全是纯甜发糖。

examples.en: Fans keep joking that this show serves a heartbreak plot every other week to keep them emotionally hooked.
examples.zh: 粉丝老开玩笑说这剧每隔一周就发一次刀子，好让大家一直上头。

entries.shortAnswer: 「签售会」英文是 autograph session，指艺人现场签名并常卖专辑周边的互动活动。
entries.definition: autograph session 强调签名环节，常搭配 hold/attend an autograph session；若侧重卖专辑可叫 signing event。

examples.en: Hundreds of fans lined up outside the bookstore for the author's autograph session.
examples.zh: 数百名粉丝在书店外排队等待作者的签售会。

examples.en: The K-pop group held an autograph session after their comeback showcase, and fans brought albums to be signed.
examples.zh: 这个韩流组合在回归秀之后举办了签售会，粉丝们带着专辑来签名。

entries.shortAnswer: Autograph session means 签售会: a signing event where fans meet a star and get items signed.
entries.definition: autograph session 指明星粉丝签名会，常与专辑、书籍或周边售卖绑定。搭配 hold/attend an autograph session。

examples.en: Hundreds of fans lined up outside the bookstore for the author's autograph session.
examples.zh: 数百名粉丝在书店外排队等待作者的签售会。

examples.en: The K-pop group held an autograph session after their comeback showcase, and fans brought albums to be signed.
examples.zh: 这个韩流组合在回归秀之后举办了签售会，粉丝们带着专辑来签名。

entries.shortAnswer: 荧光棒英文是glow stick，演唱会粉丝常挥舞它为爱豆应援，是追星必备道具。
entries.definition: glow stick指内含化学发光液的塑料软管，演唱会和夜跑常见；在粉丝应援中也叫light stick。

examples.en: She waved a pink glow stick in the crowd to support her favorite idol.
examples.zh: 她在人群中挥舞着粉色荧光棒，为最喜欢的爱豆应援。

examples.en: The venue was filled with thousands of glow sticks in different colors, each marking a fan group.
examples.zh: 现场满是颜色各异的荧光棒，每种颜色都代表不同的粉丝群体。

entries.shortAnswer: A glow stick, 荧光棒 in Chinese, is waved by fans at concerts to cheer for idols.
entries.definition: A glow stick is a chemiluminescent tube used at concerts; in fan culture it is a light stick in many colors.

examples.en: She waved a pink glow stick in the crowd to support her favorite idol.
examples.zh: 她在人群中挥舞着粉色荧光棒，为最喜欢的爱豆应援。

examples.en: The venue was filled with thousands of glow sticks in different colors, each marking a fan group.
examples.zh: 现场满是颜色各异的荧光棒，每种颜色都代表不同的粉丝群体。

entries.shortAnswer: 「抢票」英文是 snap up tickets，指开票瞬间飞快抢购，强调速度与竞争。
entries.definition: 抢票即 snap up tickets，多用于演唱会、球赛开票即售罄的场景，比 buy tickets 更突出秒杀感。

examples.en: Thousands of fans tried to snap up tickets for the reunion tour, but the site crashed within seconds.
examples.zh: 成千上万的粉丝试图抢重组巡演的票，但网站几秒钟就崩溃了。

examples.en: She set three alarms to snap up tickets the moment they were released, and still missed out.
examples.zh: 她设了三个闹钟，就为了在开票那一刻抢票，结果还是没抢到。

entries.shortAnswer: Snap up tickets means 抢票: buying tickets fast the moment they go on sale.
entries.definition: Snap up tickets is informal, used for concerts or limited events where tickets sell out fast.

examples.en: Thousands of fans tried to snap up tickets for the reunion tour, but the site crashed within seconds.
examples.zh: 成千上万的粉丝试图抢重组巡演的票，但网站几秒钟就崩溃了。

examples.en: She set three alarms to snap up tickets the moment they were released, and still missed out.
examples.zh: 她设了三个闹钟，就为了在开票那一刻抢票，结果还是没抢到。

entries.shortAnswer: 「加场」的英文是 extra show，指热门演出因需求火爆而临时追加的场次，不要直译成 add a show。
entries.definition: extra show 多用于演唱会、音乐剧等售票演出，常搭配 announce an extra show、due to overwhelming demand。added date 更强调新增日期，常见于票务网站；加场不等于加座。

examples.en: Due to overwhelming demand, the promoter announced an extra show in Shanghai.
examples.zh: 由于需求火爆，主办方宣布在上海加场。

examples.en: Tickets for the extra show sold out in less than ten minutes.
examples.zh: 加场的门票不到十分钟就卖光了。

entries.shortAnswer: extra show 的中文意思是「加场」，指在原定场次之外临时增加的演出场次，与 extra seats（加座）不同。
entries.definition: extra show 用于演唱会、戏剧等售票演出，常见搭配 announce an extra show、due to overwhelming demand。正式票务文案也写作 added date，语气更中性。

examples.en: Due to overwhelming demand, the promoter announced an extra show in Shanghai.
examples.zh: 由于需求火爆，主办方宣布在上海加场。

examples.en: Tickets for the extra show sold out in less than ten minutes.
examples.zh: 加场的门票不到十分钟就卖光了。

entries.shortAnswer: 「返图」英文是 fan-taken photos，指粉丝拍完并分享回圈内的照片，强调分享闭环。
entries.definition: fan-taken photos 多指粉丝在活动或机场拍到并修好发回圈内的照片，重点在拍完分享回圈内。

examples.en: She posted a set of fan-taken photos from the concert, and the whole fandom saved them.
examples.zh: 她发了演唱会的返图，整个饭圈都保存了。

examples.en: These fan-taken photos are so clear that some people mistook them for official teasers.
examples.zh: 这些返图太清晰了，有人误以为是官方预告照。

entries.shortAnswer: Fan-taken photos 中文叫「返图」，指粉丝拍摄并分享回圈内的照片，常会先修图再发回圈子。
entries.definition: Fan-taken photos means pictures shot by fans and shared back to the fandom, often edited first before posting.

examples.en: She posted a set of fan-taken photos from the concert, and the whole fandom saved them.
examples.zh: 她发了演唱会的返图，整个饭圈都保存了。

examples.en: These fan-taken photos are so clear that some people mistook them for official teasers.
examples.zh: 这些返图太清晰了，有人误以为是官方预告照。

entries.shortAnswer: 「见面会」的英文就是 fan meeting，指偶像与粉丝近距离互动的线下活动，常包含聊天、游戏与合影。
entries.definition: fan meeting 源自韩流文化，常搭配 hold、attend 等动词；它比演唱会更重互动，包括聊天、游戏、合影等环节。

examples.en: I flew to Seoul just to attend my favorite idol's fan meeting.
examples.zh: 我专门飞首尔，就为了参加我最喜欢的偶像的见面会。

examples.en: The fan meeting included a Q&A session, games, and a group photo with the singer.
examples.zh: 这场见面会包括问答环节、游戏，还有和歌手的合影。

entries.shortAnswer: A fan meeting is「见面会」in Chinese, an intimate offline event where idols interact closely with fans.
entries.definition: A fan meeting is an intimate event where idols chat, play games and take photos with fans, focusing on interaction rather than performance.

examples.en: I flew to Seoul just to attend my favorite idol's fan meeting.
examples.zh: 我专门飞首尔，就为了参加我最喜欢的偶像的见面会。

examples.en: The fan meeting included a Q&A session, games, and a group photo with the singer.
examples.zh: 这场见面会包括问答环节、游戏，还有和歌手的合影。

entries.shortAnswer: 「柱子票」英文是 pillar-blocked seat，指视线被场馆立柱遮挡的座位。
entries.definition: pillar-blocked seat 指视线被立柱遮挡的座位，区别于泛指的 obstructed view seat。

examples.en: Many fans complained after buying pillar-blocked seats at the concert and demanded refunds.
examples.zh: 许多粉丝在演唱会上买到柱子票后纷纷投诉，要求退款。

examples.en: The venue apologized and offered to exchange pillar-blocked seats for better ones.
examples.zh: 场馆道歉，并提出将柱子票更换为视野更好的座位。

entries.shortAnswer: A pillar-blocked seat is 柱子票, a seat with a view blocked by a venue pillar.
entries.definition: Pillar-blocked seat means 柱子票, a seat whose view is blocked by a pillar. Narrower than obstructed view seat.

examples.en: Many fans complained after buying pillar-blocked seats at the concert and demanded refunds.
examples.zh: 许多粉丝在演唱会上买到柱子票后纷纷投诉，要求退款。

examples.en: The venue apologized and offered to exchange pillar-blocked seats for better ones.
examples.zh: 场馆道歉，并提出将柱子票更换为视野更好的座位。

entries.shortAnswer: 「周边」的英文是 official merch，口语常简作 merch，正式场合用 official merchandise。
entries.definition: official merch 指围绕某个 IP、艺人或作品推出的官方授权衍生品，包括徽章、立牌、痛包等。

examples.en: I spent way too much on official merch at the concert last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚演唱会上我花太多钱买官方周边了。

examples.en: The official merch store just dropped a new line of ita bags and badges.
examples.zh: 官方周边店刚上架了一批新的痛包和徽章。

entries.shortAnswer: Official merch is the English for 周边, meaning licensed products tied to an IP, idol, or franchise.
entries.definition: Official merch means licensed merchandise from a brand or creator, not fan-made goods; often shortened to merch.

examples.en: I spent way too much on official merch at the concert last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚演唱会上我花太多钱买官方周边了。

examples.en: The official merch store just dropped a new line of ita bags and badges.
examples.zh: 官方周边店刚上架了一批新的痛包和徽章。

entries.shortAnswer: 「吧唧」的英文是 anime badge，特指动漫、游戏等二次元周边中的马口铁徽章。注意别直接说 badge，那只是普通徽章，anime badge 才对应粉丝圈语境。
entries.definition: 吧唧是 badge 的音译，专指二次元圈的马口铁徽章（pin badge），常印角色或CP图案，用于装饰痛包、交换、应援。口语也作「谷子」的一种；说英语时用 anime badge 或 can badge，别只说 badge。

examples.en: She decorated her ita bag with dozens of anime badges of her favorite character.
examples.zh: 她用几十个最喜欢的角色的吧唧装饰了自己的痛包。

examples.en: I traded an anime badge with a fellow fan at the convention.
examples.zh: 我在漫展上和一位同好交换了一个吧唧。

entries.shortAnswer: Anime badge 的中文意思是「吧唧」，即二次元粉丝圈常见的马口铁徽章。它与普通 pin badge 不同，专指印有动漫、游戏角色的周边徽章。
entries.definition: Anime badge 指动漫周边中的马口铁徽章，中文音译为「吧唧」，是「谷子」的核心品类。英语中也可说 can badge 或 pin badge，但在粉丝语境下 anime badge 更准确，不要与普通徽章混用。

examples.en: She decorated her ita bag with dozens of anime badges of her favorite character.
examples.zh: 她用几十个最喜欢的角色的吧唧装饰了自己的痛包。

examples.en: I traded an anime badge with a fellow fan at the convention.
examples.zh: 我在漫展上和一位同好交换了一个吧唧。

entries.shortAnswer: 「开场嘉宾」的英文是 opening act，指演唱会正式开场前登台暖场的表演者。注意 opening act 是整场演出的第一个表演环节，不是主持人。
entries.definition: opening act 常与 tour、concert 搭配，如 be the opening act for…；口语中也说 opener。它特指为压轴主秀（headliner）暖场的艺人，与嘉宾主持（host）概念不同。

examples.en: The opening act played for only twenty minutes before the headliner took the stage.
examples.zh: 开场嘉宾只表演了二十分钟，随后主秀就登台了。

examples.en: She got her start as an opening act for a famous rock band on their world tour.
examples.zh: 她最初是在一支著名摇滚乐队的世界巡演中担任开场嘉宾起步的。

entries.shortAnswer: Opening act 的中文意思是「开场嘉宾」，即演唱会主秀前先登台暖场的表演者。它强调暖场功能，不等同于客串嘉宾（guest performer）。
entries.definition: Opening act 指演出中为主打艺人（headliner）预热的第一组表演者，常见搭配 open for sb、serve as the opening act。口语缩略为 opener，正式报道中仍用 opening act。

examples.en: The opening act played for only twenty minutes before the headliner took the stage.
examples.zh: 开场嘉宾只表演了二十分钟，随后主秀就登台了。

examples.en: She got her start as an opening act for a famous rock band on their world tour.
examples.zh: 她最初是在一支著名摇滚乐队的世界巡演中担任开场嘉宾起步的。

entries.shortAnswer: 「返场」的英文是 encore，源自法语 encore（意为“再来一次”）。注意：返场是观众喊出来的加演，不是歌手主动加歌。
entries.definition: encore 作名词指“返场加演”，作动词/感叹词指“喊返场”。常见搭配：do an encore（返场表演）、call for an encore（喊返场）、encore performance（返场演出）。易错点：返场不是安可，安可只是音译。

examples.en: The audience shouted for an encore, and the band came back to play two more songs.
examples.zh: 观众大喊返场，乐队又回来加演了两首歌。

examples.en: She performed an encore of her biggest hit, even though her voice was slightly hoarse.
examples.zh: 尽管嗓子有点哑，她还是返场表演了她的最热门歌曲。

entries.shortAnswer: Encore 的中文意思是「返场」，即演出结束后观众要求加演的环节。与中文「加演」不同，encore 强调观众喊出来的互动。
entries.definition: Encore 源自法语 encore（再次），在英语中作名词指返场表演，作动词/感叹词指观众喊返场。常见搭配：play an encore、encore call。注意：encore 不指正式演出中的加演曲目。

examples.en: The audience shouted for an encore, and the band came back to play two more songs.
examples.zh: 观众大喊返场，乐队又回来加演了两首歌。

examples.en: She performed an encore of her biggest hit, even though her voice was slightly hoarse.
examples.zh: 尽管嗓子有点哑，她还是返场表演了她的最热门歌曲。

entries.shortAnswer: 「巡演」的英文是 concert tour，指歌手在多座城市连续举办的系列演唱会。注意它区别于单场演出。
entries.definition: concert tour 指同一主题在多座城市巡回举办的系列演出。常见搭配：go on a concert tour、a world concert tour。

examples.en: The band announced a world concert tour to promote their new album, with stops in Shanghai, Tokyo, and London.
examples.zh: 这支乐队宣布开启世界巡演以宣传新专辑，途经上海、东京和伦敦。

examples.en: She cried when the concert tour ended because she had followed her idol to five different cities.
examples.zh: 巡演结束时她哭了，因为她一路追着偶像跑了五座城市。

entries.shortAnswer: Concert tour means 「巡演」: a series of concerts by an artist in many cities, not just one show.
entries.definition: A concert tour is a planned series of concerts in different cities. Common collocations: go on a concert tour, kick off a concert tour.

examples.en: The band announced a world concert tour to promote their new album, with stops in Shanghai, Tokyo, and London.
examples.zh: 这支乐队宣布开启世界巡演以宣传新专辑，途经上海、东京和伦敦。

examples.en: She cried when the concert tour ended because she had followed her idol to five different cities.
examples.zh: 巡演结束时她哭了，因为她一路追着偶像跑了五座城市。

entries.shortAnswer: 「谷子」英文是 anime merch goods，指动漫游戏周边；吧唧即徽章，吃谷即买周边。
entries.definition: 谷子是 goods 音译黑话，指动漫游戏等二次元周边，如吧唧、立牌、色纸。英语多说 anime merch goods 或 merch。

examples.en: She spent all her savings on anime merch goods at the convention, especially badges and acrylic stands.
examples.zh: 她在漫展上把积蓄全花在了谷子上，尤其是徽章和立牌。

examples.en: Fans often trade anime merch goods online to complete their collections.
examples.zh: 粉丝们经常在网上交换谷子来集齐收藏。

entries.shortAnswer: 谷子 in Chinese means anime merch goods, i.e. anime and game merchandise such as badges and stands.
entries.definition: Anime merch goods are physical products tied to anime or games, like badges and acrylic stands. In casual English, merch is more common.

examples.en: She spent all her savings on anime merch goods at the convention, especially badges and acrylic stands.
examples.zh: 她在漫展上把积蓄全花在了谷子上，尤其是徽章和立牌。

examples.en: Fans often trade anime merch goods online to complete their collections.
examples.zh: 粉丝们经常在网上交换谷子来集齐收藏。

entries.shortAnswer: 痛包英文叫 ita bag，指带透明夹层、挂满徽章周边的展示包，源自日语痛バッグ。
entries.definition: 痛包即 ita bag，源自日语「痛バッグ」，指用透明夹层展示徽章、吧唧等周边的包。常见搭配：make an ita bag。易错：别译成 painful bag。

examples.en: She spent the whole weekend arranging her badges on her ita bag before the fan meeting.
examples.zh: 为了粉丝见面会，她整个周末都在把徽章往痛包上摆。

examples.en: At the concert, everyone carried an ita bag covered in merch, so the queue looked like a mini exhibition.
examples.zh: 演唱会上每个人都背着挂满周边的痛包，排队队伍像个小展览。

entries.shortAnswer: An ita bag is a 痛包: a bag with clear panels packed with badges and idol merch, from Japanese 痛バッグ.
entries.definition: Ita bag means 痛包, a bag with transparent panels displaying pins and idol goods, from Japanese 痛バッグ. Not a plain backpack.

examples.en: She spent the whole weekend arranging her badges on her ita bag before the fan meeting.
examples.zh: 为了粉丝见面会，她整个周末都在把徽章往痛包上摆。

examples.en: At the concert, everyone carried an ita bag covered in merch, so the queue looked like a mini exhibition.
examples.zh: 演唱会上每个人都背着挂满周边的痛包，排队队伍像个小展览。
